rol gyi rig pa bcing bar 'dod na/ ming nas smos te ras kyi kha tshar la brgyad brgyar mngon par bsngags nas mdud pa bcing bar bya'o/ /gal te sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rang byung du byon yang / des kyang ji srid rig pa 'dzin pas bkrol 17gyi bar du dgrol ponarabar mi nus so/ /zhi bar 'dod pas sna ma'i me tog stong phrag brgyad dbul bar bya ste/ zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /slong 5mo za bas bye ba yongs su bzlas par bya ste/ mngon sum du bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'di casastong phrag bcur bzlas pas gzhan nad kyis btab pa rab tu 'joms par byed do/ /slong 5rimo za zhing bye ba yongs su bzlas na bcom ldan 'das mthong ste mchog gsum stsol nebar mdzad do/ /sems can thams cad dbang du byed pa dang / mi snang ba dang / lha ma yin gyi khyim du 'jug 7 pa'o/ /ri'i rtse mor 'dzegs nas bye ba yongs su bzlas na /lha thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing rtag tu yang mthong ba stsol 9bar byedasna / pad+ma can gyi mtshor pad+ma dkar po'i sbyin sreg stong phrag bcu bya'o / /rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bklags pa tsam gyis thams cad yongs su 'grub par 'gyur te 'dod pas nye bar bzhag pa ni ma gtogs so/lha/ /mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas te me long la yongs su bzlas nas sbyin sreg gi thal bas khye'u 'am bu mo la bstan 12par bya 12ste/ ma nyams ma zad par mthong ngo / / mthe bo'i 1 sen rtsi dang dri'i til mar gyis byugs nas byis pa rnams la bstan par bya'o/ /snod chus gang bar byas nas thams cad la bstan par bya ste/thams cad mthong zhing sems can thams cad dbang du byed do/ /lan bdun du bzlas pas dbang du 'gyur ros/ /grong du rab tu zhugs nas bza' ba don du 94—96

gnyer na stong bzlas par bya'o/ /bza' ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /chom rkun gyi 'jigs pa la bzlas pas rengs par byed do/ /bye ba bzlas pas las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /zla ba gzas bzung ba nas ba ra ha ka mi ku'i rtsa ba blangs nas lag pa kha sbyar bas mnan te ji srid dngos grub rnam pa gsum du gyur pa 1)de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /nyi ma gzas bzung ba na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar ji srid dngos grub rnam pa gsum du gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /chu klung du song zhing 'o ma dang / nas zan za zhing bye ba bzlas na klu thams cad 'ong bar byed cing de rnams dbang du 'gyur ro / /de nas sgrub pa pos klu'i gnas kyi dngos grub 'byung bar bya ste/ klu'i gnas thams cad du ji ltar 'dod 2pa bzhin rang gi khyim bzhin du rnam par rgyu bar byed do/ /klu'i gnas su song nas 'o thug gis lhung bzed bkang nas ji srid klu mgo bo bdun pa 'ong bar byed pa de srid du rig pa bzlas par bya'o/ /rin po che rnams kyang sbyin par byed do/ /sa la rgyal po'i gter 'don pa'am 'ching bar byed do/ /de nas gcig tu yang dag par blang bar bya ste/ ma blangs na klu'i 'ching ba lnga 'ong bar byed do/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis stong phrag nyi shu rtsa gcig tu chu klung gi 'gram du bzlas pa dbul bar bya'o/ /rgyun 'bab pa'i chu klung chen po'i me tog rnams g.yas su 'khor bar byed na / rig pa 'dzin pas grub bo zhes shes par bya'o/ /de nas chu'i nang du 'ong ba dang 'gro bar byed do / /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam/ byang chub kyi shing drung du bye ba bzlas par bya'o/ /tshul khrims dang ldan pa spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyal por 'gyur te/ 'dzam bu'i ragling gi dbang phyug /rig pa 'dzin pa'i 94—97

'khor los sgyur 1ba rdzu 'phrul chen po dang mthu chen po can ji srid du bsgrubs pa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pa gnyis pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas pad+ma 'byung ste 'dab ma dga' ba dang bcas pa dri yid du 'ong ba'i pad+ma de blangs pas zas su dga' ba za ba'i lang tsho dang ldan pa smyon skra li zhing 'khyil pa lo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa lha gzhon nu rnams las lhag pa'i gzi brjid dang /bde ba dang / yid bde ba mang bar 'gyur ro/ /lo bye ba brgya stong phrag tu 'tsho zhing 'phur bar byed do/ /bā sha ku'i me tog stong phrag brgyar sbyin sreg bya ste/gser stong rnyed do/ /seng ldeng gi shing gi me sbar nas mya ngan med pa'i me tog mar la btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na gnod sbyin dbang du 'gyur ro/ /chos bzhin pas ni yid kyis /nostong phrag brgyad cu sbyin sreg byas na yid rtse gcig pa nyid lus me dang mtshungs pa stobs dang pha rol gnon pa thogs pa med pa'i rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang bye ba bzlas par bya ste/mngon sum du spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong ngo / /gang 'dod pa de rnyed do / /yid kyis 'bum phrag brgyad cu rnams kyis mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /dpag tshad brgyad du 'phur bar byed do/ /'og tu yang dpag tshad brgyar 'gro bar byed do/ /sa la yang steng du 'byin par byed do/ /gter thams cad mthong bar byed do/ /gnod sbyin mo rnams dbang du bya bar 'dod pas mya ngan med pa'i shing gi 'og tu dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs pa byas nas 'di gsol cig ces brjod par bya'o/ /gzhan yang 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i cho gar 'gyur 4te sngon spyad pa bya zhing gso sbyong la gnas pas dus gsum du khrus bya zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa la dkyil 'khor byas nas 5'bum 94—98

phrag gsum bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa 17yongs su rdzogs pa na gso sbyong la gnas pa nyid kyis ji ltar nus pa'i mchod pa byas nas chu stod can gyi nazla ba nya la dge 'dun gyis bstan pa'i bsod snyoms kyi 5zas bza' bar bya zhing sha dang bral ba'i shin tu gya rnam pas dri gtsang khang du dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs pa byas nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i sku'am/ gzugs brnyan la dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pa rnams kyis mchod pa byas nas ku sha bting ba la skyil krung bcings 54te bsod snyoms kyi 5zas kyis las kyi dpag tu med pa'i bzlas pa dbul bar bya'o/ /ji srid sgrub pa gnyis pa'o/ /zhes pa de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das mthong bar byed do/ /gang 'dod cing 'dod pa rnyed do/ /'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i rtog pa nebacom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brjes kyi ri rtsa ba'i rtog pa na'ajig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba rig pa'i rgyal po chen po'i rtog pa rdzogs so// //de nas yang sems dpa' chen pos slar yang rig pa thams cad yang dag par skul 9)bar byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sgrub thabs kyi cho ga rig pa'i le'u gsungs par 1 gyur to/ /bklags 11pas grub pa myur du grub cing rang gis bdag nyid grub pa g.yeng 1 ba'i don grub pa/ mdor na ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba/ de lta de ltar 'grub par 'gyur te/ de ji lta ba bzhin rtog par bya bar 'gyur ro/ /yang 'dir rig pa ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+ya 1 a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bibyā de ba tā ya1 / na mo bibyā de ba tā māṃ na ma/ sarba kyai 15ba/ bit+yā ku la baṃ sha 94—99

gye17 / tar+ya thā/ sarba ar+sha bi n+ni (5)bi nā sha (guya ā ha ri/ ha re ha re/ bi ha re / bi hā te dza (44bi ma le/ a bha ye/ tsa lo/ stam+bha ni/ puska re/ shudhe muk+ki muk+kir/ bi kur bi te/ pra bhā swa re ā (9)lo ki te bh+yaḥ/(7) bi lā ni)ka la/sarba satwa(/ a ba lo ka ni swā hā/ rig pa 'dis las 'di rnams su 'gyur te bsnyen pa'i dus dang sgrub pa'i dus su yang dang po nyid du bdag nyid bsrung bar bya'o / /bslab pas bcing ba'i 7grogs rnams kyang lan bdun nas lan gsum bzlas pa'i chu spyi bor blugs pas thams cad du bsrung 11ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /dri dang / me tog dang / bdug pa dang / bsngags pa la sogs pa yang 'di nyid kyis bya'o/ /ras ris blangs te lha rnams dang ras ris la kun tu bsrung tu ba dang / ras ris kyi gnas su tshon gzhan dang ma 'dres pa dang / spyan drangs pa'i lha rnams la mchod yon dbul ba dang / yang dag par gnas pa dang / bdag nyid dang grogs byed pa rnams kyang 'di nyid kyis khu ba bcing bar bya'o/ /khu ba bcings pas log 'dren thams cad 'joms pa dang /gnas kun tu bsrung 1 ba'o/ /'di nyid kyis tsha ba'i til mar gyis btags pa'i yungs kur dkar po'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /bdag nyid dang grogs byed pa rnams kyang rung ste lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu phyogs gang du sngon du bsnyen pa dang / sgrub pa dang / zhi ba can dang / rgyas pa can dang /mngon spyod can ci yin pa de nyid du gdon mi za bar bya'o/ /yang na gzhan du thang gi phyogs sam/ sa'i gnas bcom ldan 'das bsgrub par bya ba'am/gzhan las bya ba der byi dor dang por bya'o/ /rnam pa 'dis gtor ma sbyong ba dang / bdag nyid srung khob dang / gzhan srung ba dang / chu blugs pa dang /94wa 100

mdor na sgrub pa dang / las gang cung zad yin pa de 'dis bsrung ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /srung ba'i rig pa ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 1)ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā yanano/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ri riya/ na mo bha ga ba tre+e/ tā rā yi / ā (gegats+tsha de bi/ pad+ma haste na/ ba de/ pad+ma haste/ ya sho ba ti/ro ṣa ṇa shī r+ghaṃ ā gats+tsha/ ma hā de bi gi/ ma hā bi gi/ ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/tsa la tsa la/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ bha ga ba te/ i rda gan+dha 5sut+pa/ mā l+ya/ sarba nī yaṃ/ pra yats+tsha tha/ bud+dha 76sate na/ dharma sarkye na/ saṃ gha sate na swā hā/rig pa dang po gang yin pa des dkyil 'khor gyi cho gas dkyil 'khor la rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /rig 7)pa 'dis a ga ru'i bdug pa dang sngar brjod pa'i rig pas lan gsum mam bdun bzlas pas bye dor dang lan nyi shu rtsa gcig mngon par bsngags nas sgrub pa ni rig pa bzlas par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma spyan drang bar bya ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo nas mi tā bhā 9)ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā 1 satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba h+ye/ ār+ya tā rā yi/artate / su gan+dha/ mā l+ya/ pri ye/ tsan+t+ra/ tsan+t+ra 11ma ti/ gan+ta nu le pa 412/pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ 'dis mchod yon dbul zhing 1 dri dang gdan yang ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 1 ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā tshaya/ ma hā satā ya/ na ma ār+ya tā rā yi/ hi li hi li/ mi li mi li/ ma hā pra bhā ye/ brah+ma su ma no nu ru ha/ha ra ha ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ de bi pra 7sā dha 1 ku ru pra tīts+tsha tha put+pa 94—101

swā hā/ me tog gi rig pa ste 'dis me tog rnams dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 1ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya(5ci/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba h+ye/ ār+ya tā rā yi/ bo dhi satā ya/ man+t+ra/ ma nu sma ra/ sarba de ba/ pri ye bha ga ba ti / a ba lo ki ni/ sid+dha sid+dha pra thā ne/ bud+dha satre na/ dharma satre na/ saṃ gha sa6 na swā hā/ bdug pa'i rig pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā 4ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma (5ri.ār+ya a 6ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā dru 7te/ badz+ra dhu na/ a nu dzin/ be gi/ be gi/ dhu ru dhu ru sarba dzī ba/ pri ye/ bud+dhā 9rasatre na/ dharma satre na/ saṃ gha sarkye 1 na swā hā/gtor ma'i rig pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 11ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya 12a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā ka 12ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bha ga ba h+ye/ ār+ya tā rā yi/ a pra ti ha te/ bha ga ba te ā ha re ha re pad+ma bha si ni shī t+t+waṃ ge/ she ta bhu dze/ dhu me dhu me/ bud+dha ngasatre na/ dharma sarkye na/ saṃ gha satre na swā hā5/'di ni mar me'i rig 7pa'o/ /de bzhin du rig pa 'dis rab tu sbyar bar bya'o//sngon du bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la thams cad mtshungs pa nyid du sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'i rig pa ni/ na mo rat+na tra 1 yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 1 ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta 19te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā yi / tabya thā/ ā ga ma/ ā ga ma/ ga ga na ta la/ saṃ 1sra tso/ di gas+t+ya/ sarba bit+yā na/ dha 94wa 102

ra / bi sho dha ni swā hā/ rig pa 'dis lan nyi shu rtsa gcig tu chu la yongs su bzlas nas bum pa la sogs pa bdag nyid la mngon par gtor bar bya ste khrus kyi rig pa'o/ /'di nyid kyis lha rnams la yang khrus gsol ba'i rig pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 1ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya / na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha (rig ba te ār+ya tā rā yi/ dhu dhu me/ dhu dhu me/ khu khu me/ khu khu me/ nā shud+dha / sid+dhi mañtsa niri / shud+dhi kā re/ shu tsa ni swā hā/ rig pa 'di sgrub pa pos rtag tu gos la lan cig 4)gam/ lan bdun bzlas la yongs su bcang bar bya'o / /rnam pa gzhan du log par 'dren pa rnams kyis nges par ston no/ /gdon mi za ba kho nar sgrub pa pos bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra 5྅ ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā (6)ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki 7te shwa rā ya/ bo na dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te/ ār+ya tā rā yi9 / shān+ti/ me ka ro hi1 / sharnyi 11mā te12/ shi shān+ta/ ni shān+ta/ ka lbā 1 ṇi ni shān+ta/ bi dza ye lha / de bi ba ra de swā hā/ rig pa 'dis bdag nyid la lan bdun bzlas nas gnyid log par bya'o/ /rmi lam du log par 'dren pa mi mthong ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 7ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te15/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 1 ya/ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba 1/ti 19ār+ya tā rā yi/ srur+ya ta u pa ri/ tra byin /dha 21ra ṇi/ brnyi ti/ gar+bha 22sho dha ni/ ku tsa mā li ni/ shu tra na bi sho 2 dha ni swā hā/ ku 25sha bi sho 20dha ni swā hā/ ku shas mdud pa nyi shu rtsa gcig 2 byas te/khu ba 'ching ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā na ya/94—103

ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle 51)bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā 25ya/ ma hā satā ri ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā yi/ ha ri piṅga (geli / ha ri ha ri/ hi bha ga bha 55)ba ti/ a tsa la pra tiṣ+ṭha nyu)te/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ/ku sha biṇ+ḍa ma bsgri ta su/ bud+dha sarkye na/ dharma sate na/ saṃ gha sarkye na swā hā/rig pa 'dis ku sha'i khres la mngon par bsngags nas nye bar 'dug par 7)bya'o / /na mo rat+na tra yā 8ya/ na mo 59a mi tā bhā 7ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te 11shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā tu ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā yi/ di shi 12ba di shi brnya ni/ su de bi skisu pra sā ste/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ hasta/ ka la ba la/ ka la ba la/ba ba/ he la he la/ ku ru ku ru/ bud+dha satre na/ dharma sarkye na/ saṃ gha satre na gan+dha gan+dha/ bi ma le swā hā/ dkyil 'khor bcing ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā 5ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma 8ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 1 ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā yi/ dza la dza la/ dza la/ k+ko bha ya/ na sha 18ni dza la sho dha ni/ sa mi ri ṇi/ dza la hā si ṇi/ bi sho dha ṇi swā hā/ nye reg gi rig pa'o/ /sgrub pa po dngos grub 'dod pas rig pa 'dis bdag nyid la nges par sbyar bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 19ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma 2 /ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā saḥyi/ sarba de bā su marnye a saṃ ga tā re/ a saṃ ga bi mu/ a saṃ ga ti muk+ta bi muk+ta/ bi dza ye/nir mā kyai/ a pa ri kulpe ni/ put+pa gan+dha bi sho dha ni/ bi sho ṣa ya/ hi da ma 94wa 104

ṇi / da (1)ma ni swā hā/ rig pa 'dis dri med nyid gsal bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/na ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya / na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā (miru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā yi / sarba satā 5kri ta/ pri 5kri ta / pri k+ṣa(7)/ kri ta/ sa ka 8)le da se/ sa ka lo bi sho dha ni swā hā/ rig pa 'dis lha bshos dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra 9 yā ya/ na mo a mi tā 1 bhā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā 11ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bha ga ba ti ār+ya tā rā yi/ swasna pa ṇi/ge/ badzā/lha/ gardzas/ mir+sha ya/ pra t+yaḥtsha/ bā e baṃ/byā hā ra/ ka thā tshaya swā hā/ rig pa 'dis bcom ldan 'das ma la mchod pa byas nas seng ldeng gi shing gis me sbar nas nu la ka brti la mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong brgyad brgya byas na/ rmi lam ston par byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te a mi tā 1 bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā 18ya/ ma hā satā 10ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā tshoyi/ e hi bha ga bān/ ār+ya a ba lo ki 37te shwa rā bha tī 22na ma bha yaṃ ka ra bā lā nā ma bhā yaṃ/ da da/ bhak+ta nā/ mtho ka ra/ a tra 3 tsā 43 / tra ya ka /duḥkhri tā māṃ/ sau khye gi/ ka ra ma ma/bha ga ba te/ ma nu kai saṃ/ ka re hi/ bha ga bān tsi/ ā 2 gats+tsha ā gats+tsha i 28mo/gan+dha put+pa/ ba li/ dhu partse 29ta/ grit+na/ tar+ya thā/ pra sā de pra sā de ba ti/ma hā/ de bi/ ma hā pra bhe/ srur+ya pra bhe/ a mo ghi/ a mo gha sa ti 1/ ya sho ba tis / a mo gha saṃ dar+sha nar / a mo gha bi ma lam̐/ a mo gha ha lo/ tsa la 94wa 105

tsa la/ sa 1skur sa rinacir/ ha ra ha ra/ tra ye/ hi rma/ sidhi ra me/ da da swā hā / nus pa dang ldan pa'i sgrub pa pos rig pa 'dis dri dang / me tog dang /gtor ma rab tu dbul bar bya zhing / bsnyen pa'i dus dang sgrub pa'i dus der ram gzhan gang cung zad 'bras bu la sogs pa de thams cad 'di nyid kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /'dis lha rnams sbyong ba dang / dge ba'i rmi lam dang /dbul ba dang / bstod pa dang / sgrub pa pos glegs bam klog pa dang /mchod rten gyi ri rilas la sogs pa thams cad 'di nyid kyis dbul bar bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 5ya ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle 'bud+dhā ya / na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 75ru ṇi kā ya/ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya tā rā 8yi/ tar+ya thā/ ma ra ma ra/ban+dha brnya/ ha na ha na/ pu ra pu 9ra/ la la/ la la/ ra ra/ ra ra/tsa la tsa la/ kha kha/ kha kha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ bud+dha sarkye na/ dharma sate na/ saṃ gha 1 satre na swā hā/ rig pa 'di'i thal bas sgrub pa po'i dkyil 'khor bcing ba'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā 11ya/ ta thā ga tā ya / arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo rnyi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ na mo bha ga ba 12te ār+ya tā rā 1 yi/ tar+ya thā/ hi ri hi ri/ mi ri mi ri/ ki ri ki ri/ ghi ri ghi ri/ ghu ru ghu ru/ ba ra ba ra/da ra da ra/ gats+tsha gats+tsha/ bha ga bān/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya / ma hā satā 1 ya/ ya thā su kho15/ rig pa 'dis me tog gi snyim pa'i phyag rgya dang lhan cig pas bskul bar 'gyur te/ gshegs su gsol ba'i rig pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na maḥsasarba de ba ni1 / na mo bit+yā 1 de bā māṃ/ na ma ār+ya 94wa 106

a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 15ru ṇi kā ya/e hi bha ga ba te ma hā rak+ṣa si tsa 2 se ṭi/ khri ṭi misbyin/ 4a su ra pra marda ni5/e ka dza ṭi/ ti (65rāk+ṣa si/ sa hi ta de bi ma tsam sā/ bi he 7thi ya/ ki 58ri si ti/ rā ka pā li/ ka ra 9pa ri/ kā mā 1 ri 11rka pa ra kā li ts+tsha ṭa pri ye/ ma hā ka pā li tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍa 12li/ sirnyi sarba arba/ sā dha ni/ sarba bisna/pra /lha ḍā sa ni 1 swā hā/ 'di ni srin mo ral pa gcig ma zhes bya ba ngaste/ de'i spyan sngar dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs te rig pa 'dis dri dang me tog dang gtor ma dang bdug pa la nyi ma so sor mngon par bsngags nas mchod par bya'o/ /'di skad ces brjod par bya zhing / bdag la bgegs thams cad mi g.yo bar gyur cig /de yang bdag la bgegs kyis shig /de lta bu'i 10sgrub pa po la bgegs med par 'gyur ro/ /sgrub pa po gang cung zad sgrub pa rtsom pa na bgegs med par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa gzhan du rnam par 'joms par byed do/ /zhes pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi cho ga'i rig pa 'di rnams rtog pa'i rgyal po bklags pas grub pa/ 'dir 1 ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba 12de ltar sgrub pa po'i las thams cad 'grub par byed do/ /zhes pa de bzhin du rtogs 19par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rtsa ba'i rtog pa 1sgrub thabs kyi cho ga'i rim pa'i le'u yongs su rdzogs so// //de nas yang 22sems dpa' chen pos sems can thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor la gzigs nas sems can thams cad kun tu snang bar gyur pas/ rig pa thams cad bskul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs 94—107

nas sems dpa' chen po'i 31sgrub thabs kyi rig pa gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na ( tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa dzo rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/tā re swā hā/ rig pa 'dis ri'i rtse mor slong ri rimo za bas mchod rten (57dang /khyim du thun gsum du rig pa stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /mi smra bas 'o ma dang nas zan za ba'am slong 56mo za bas ku sha bting ba la nyal te zla ba gsum mam zla ba gcig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang lhan cig tu lha mo sgrol ma mthong bar byed do/ /mchog gang slong ba 57༄rgyal srid dam/ mi snang ba'am/ phug tu 'jug pa'am/ gter 'pho ba'am/ yul gyi bdag po yang rung ste/ gang bslangs 85pa de rnyed cing rtag tu rnyed do/ /ma bsgrubs (9)par yang rig pas gtan la 'gems par byed pa dang / rdul du byed pa dang /gnon par byed pa dang / 'byin pa dang / mtshon cha 'chang ba dang / phug gi 'khrul 'khor thams cad 'gems par byed pa la bdag nyid bsrung thub byas te/g.yul du mngon par zhugs na rnam par rgyal bar byed do/ /gzhan srung na grub pa'i bya ba thams cad byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tabya thā/ tā re tā re swā hā/ rig pa 'dis zla ba gzas bzung ba'i dus su mtshan mo gsum du smyung 1lhabar gnas pa sngon du bsnyen pa byas pa'am/ bsnyen pa ma byas pa yang rung ste/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du byang chub shing gi 12yam shing gis me sbar nas sna ma'i me tog dkar po'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na dngul stong phrag brgya rnyed de yang na mthong ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā re/ tut+ta re tu re swā hā/94—108

rig pa 'dis dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes gcig nas brtsams nas sngar brjod pa'i bris sku'i cho ga bya ste mthar zla ba nya ba la dri dang / bdug pa dang gtor ma dang /me tog rnams phul nas thun gsum du stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /mtshan mo gsum du smyung (1)bar gnas te 'o ma can gyi yam shing gis me sbar nas ut+pal sngon po la zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /de nas nam mkha' la nasagrub bo grub bo zhes pa'i sgra 'byung ngo / /yang na ras ris g.yo bar byed do/ /de lta bus 2ni grub par 'gyur te/ yul dang grong dang grong khyer ram rgyal srid kyi dbang phyug so sor rnyed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi casatā ya/ ma hā satā ya/tabya thā/ tu re tu re swā hā/ rig pa 'dis 'bum phrag gcig tu bzlas nas zla ba dang nyi ma gzas bzung ba na a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma bdun gyi nang du bcug nas gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i lag pa kha sbyar gyis mnan nas ji srid dro ba dang / du ba 'thul ba dang 'bar ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /dro bar gyur pas ni dbang du byed do/ /du ba 'thul bzhin pas ni mi snang ba dang cha drug 5'phrog go / /'bar bas ni nam mkhar 6'gro'o/ /thogs pa med pa'i stobs dang /brtson 'grus dang / nyi ma 'char ku'i mdog dang / skra li zhing 'khyil ba/ lo brgyad gnyis lon pa'i rnam pa/ lo stong phrag bcur 'tsho zhing lus tha dad pa'i lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ tar+ya thā/ tu re tu re swā hā/'dis 7)rgyal gyi lcags las byung ba'i sor mo byas nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du 'bum phrag gcig bzlas nas dri dang me tog dang gtor ma'i cho ga 94—109

byas nas bsgrub par bya'o/ /du ba 'thul ba la blangs nas mi snang bar 'gyur ro//cha drug 'phrog go/ /lo stong phrag lngar 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo rnyi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/tā re/ tā rā —1yi bha ga ba ti swā hā/ rig pa 'dis til mar la lan brgyad mngon par bsngags te bskus na rma med par byed do/ /tshor ba med par byed do / /zug rngu med par byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā ka na ru ṇi kā ciya/ tar+ya thā/tā re tā re/ tut+ta ri re swā hā/ rig pa 'dis 5)'bum yongs su bzlas te lan bdun yongs su bzlas pa'i chu la gtor bar bya/ ma na ka ra dang / ru rine sbal la sogs pa'i mchu bcing ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā re tā re swā hā/ rig pa 'dis chen po rnams kyi las kyi lam thams cad byed par 'gyur ro/ /til mar la 7brgya phrag bcur yongs su bzlas nas sbyin du gzhug par bya ste/ gzir ba dang / mdoms 8kyi nad dang / gcin sri ba dang /rked pa bsdams pa la byin na nad 9med par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/tu re swā hā/ rig pa 'dis sha za'i rims dang / 'byung po'i rims dang /gdon rnam par 1 'joms pa 11la srad bus thar bar byed do/ /mi mo rab tu btsa' bzhin pa la til mar la brgyad brgyar yongs su bzlas nas lte ba'am rked par bskus 12na zug rngu med par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma 1 ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā re muḥswā 94wa 110

hā / rig pa 'dis brgyad brgyar mngon par bsngags pa byas nas/ kusnyi ra dang bā ra ṇi dang / a nan+ta dang / be 1ta shi dang / tshangs ma dang / shu dag dang / bri ha ti rnams sbrang rtsi dang yang dag par ldan pa zangs kyi snod du bzhag nas zla ba mthong ba nas ji srid grol ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de zos pas mchog tu yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa 'dis g.yul ngor 'jug pa la brgyad brgya mngon par bzlas nas lag pa la chings shig /stobs chen por 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā re tā re mu lu mu lu swā hā/ rig pa 'dis dkar po'i tshes gcig 2nas brtsams te mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas a shwat+tha'i shing gi 'og tu me tog 3yu ti ka dang / kuṇ+ḍi ka ra rnams 'o ma dang / zho dang / mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgya bya'o/ /dngul brgya rnyed pa'am/ yang na mthong ngo / /zla ba nya la mtshan mo gsum smyung bar gnas te/ mtshan phyed nas chu klung du phyin nas dri zhim po'i me tog gis sbyin sreg stong phrag brgya bya ste dong tse lnga brgya rnyed pa'am/ yang na mthong ngo /'dis la zla ba gzas bzung ba'i dus su ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du so ma rā dza'i 'bras bu rnams phye ma zhib mor 5byas nas mar dang sbrang rtsi dang bsres pa'i ril bu bya'o/ /a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma bdun gyi nang du btums nas lag pas mnan te ji srid 'bar ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de zo shigane /thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tabya thā/ tā re tā re/ tu re tu re/da ra da ra swā hā/ rig pa 'dis nyin mtshan du smyung 7bar gnas pas bcom 94—111

ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar mchod pa'i cho ga byas nas de nas rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung du song nas 'o ma dang nas zan za bas phyogs su gso sbyong byas te pad+ma dkar po kha bye ba 'bum dbul bar bya'o/ /gter mthong ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a tsho15mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki (25te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ga ciya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tabya thā/ tā re tā re/ tut+tar tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma spobs pa dang ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle 54༄bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba (7lo ki te 6nishā rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā ka 57)ru ṇi kā ya/ tā re tā re / tut+ta re tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma 'od gnyis sbyin pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ tā re tu re/ tu re swā hā/ 'di ni sgron rinama'i snying po'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ma hā kā 9ru ṇi kā ya/ tar+ya thā/ tā re tā re tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni las chen po thams cad kyi dngos grub byed pa zhes bya ba'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rig pa'o/ /de nas rig pa 'di rnams kyis mchog tu grub pa'i cho ga phyogs tsam du 'gyur te/ji lta ji ltar rab tu sbyar ba de lta de ltar sgrub par byed do/ /zhes pa de ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs par bya'o/ /mdor na 'jigs pa chen po rnams dang / las phran tshegs rnams la'ang bklags pas 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /cho ga 'di la yang rig pa sgrub par 'dod pas rig pa des ba byung lngas lus kun tu sbyangs nas 94—112

dkar po'i tshes gcig tsho1)nas brtsams te ji skad bshad pa'i rnam pas thun gsum du stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /ji srid du zla ba nya la 'bum yang rung ngo //sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mthar nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas pas mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas a ga ru nag po'i yam shing sor drug pa'i tshad la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags pa'am/ tu ruṣ+ka'i natil mar gyis btags pa'i seng ldeng gi me la stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg bya'o/ /las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro/ /de nas las su 'gyur te mthar mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pa/ gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du'am/ so so'i khyim du stong phrag bcur mngon par bsngags nas lag pa la bcings na mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du ras ris bzhugs su gsol nas pad+ma stong phrag sum cu seng ldeng gi sol bas me sbar nas sbyin sreg byas na rang gi gzugs kyi lha mo mthong ngo / /gang bslangs pa de rnyed do/ /tshes gcig canas brtsams te ji srid brtswa tshogasalnga la ne mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la mchod pa rgya chen po byas nas u dum bā 7ra'i yam nashing gis 9me sbar nas mar gyi sreg blugs 1 stong sbyin sreg byas na 11grong rnyed do/ /rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung du mchod rten stong byed du gzhug go/ /nyi ma so so re re la mchod rten la stong phrag brgyad mngon par bsngags pas dri dang me tog la sogs pa 'di la phul nas ji srid du mchod rten phyi ma 'bar ba de nas bcom ldan 'das byon par shes par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byon pa na sa g.yo ba dang dri zhim po'i rlung ldang ste/ ji srid du rang gi gzugs kyis nye bar gnas pa 94—113

de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /mchog gang slong ba'i (1)mchog stsol bar mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar seng ldeng gi 'dab ma'i dum bu'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /nyi ma so sor grong re re rnyed don / /dgon par song nas rig pa bye ba bzlas par bya'o/ /slong mo bza' zhing zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang /mar gyis btags pa'i dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci bas sbyin sreg stong phrag nyi shu bya'o / /ji srid lha rnams ri dgas 4rimo'i gzugs su byas nas 'ong bar 'gyur te de la 'jigs par mi bya'o/ /de yang gter stsol bar byed de blang bar bya'o/ /rang nyid longs shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /rgyal srid dang / nor dang /'bru dang / rin po che rnams ster bar byed de/ rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la sbyar zhing / bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya'o/ /dgon par zhugs nas rig pa stong phrag brgya bzlas par bya zhing / a ga ru'i shing la rab tu gnas pa'i spyan sngar bcom ldan 'das la shing pat+pa laṇ+ḍi ka la zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang 5ci/mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong byas na 'dod 'jo'i ba ser skyar 'ong ngo / /slar yang pat+pa laṇ+ḍi ma'i 6sbyin sreg stong phrag nyi shu bya'o/ /'ongs nas kyang grub ri rapar 'gyur te lo stong du 'o ma sbyin par byed do/ /sngar brjod pa'i ras ris kyi spyan sngar mar dang / sbrang rtsis btags pa'i sna ma'i me tog gi sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /zla ba drug tu dong tse 2stong rnyed do/ /yang na pa ṇa stong lhag pa dang bcas pa'o/ /ku mu da'i 9sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dang / sangs rgyas la mngon par dang bas 7lha rnams mchog sbyin par byed do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa byas nas yungs kur dkar po la lan bdun mngon par bsngags par 94—114

byas nas g.yul du gtor bar byas te 'di nyid stong phrag bzlas pas sems can thams cad dbang du byed nus par 'gyur ro/ /cho 'phrul gyi phyogs kyi dkar po'i bcu gsum la dri dang me tog dang bdug pas mchod pa byas nas me tog kha bye ba dang mar gyi sreg 1rlugs kyis sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /thal ba blangs nas gzhan gyi dpral bar thig le byas te/ grong dang grong khyer du rab tu 'jug par byed de/ thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nag po'i bcu bzhi nas ji srid bcwa 5)lnga'i bar du zhag gcig smyung bar gnas pas pa ṭa'i shing gi 'og tu dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa nye bar byugs te dri dang bdug pa phul nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa bya zhing gnod sbyin rnams la gtor ma phul te mi'i rus pa blangs nas rtse gsum byed du gzhug go/ /lag pa g.yon pas lan bdun 'phangs pa mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas sna ma'i me tog gi sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na rtse gsum 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas grub par 'gyur te 'dod pas gang sprul pa der 'gyur ro/ /lha'i khang par zla ba dang nyi ma gzas bzung ba na ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam sku gzugs kyi khang par ser skyar rgyud mtshungs pa'i mar srang gcig cablangs nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du gser gyi snod du bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas te zla ba mi lta ba nyid du ku shas steng nas g.yogs te bzlas par bya'o / /dro bzhin pa na btung bar bya/ sems can thams cad 5dbang du byed do / /lci ba byung ba na btung bar bya ste mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /'bar bzhin pa ni 6btung bar bya ste nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /zla ba drug tu sngon spyad pa byas pa ba'i gcin dang nas zan bza' zhing mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs spyad par bya'o/ /94—115

bcom ldan 'das ma rtag tu bzlas pas ma blangs par gser brgya rnyed do/ /cho 'phrul gyi phyogs kyi lor brtsam (1 par bya ste/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar mchod pa byas nas dri dang me tog dang bdug pa lags (snyepa de bzhin du phul te yan lag brgyad kyi gso sbyong dang yang dag par ldan pas lo rdzogs pa na 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ras ris 'ching bar byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas tshes gcig nanas brtsams te/ ji srid zla ba nya ba'i bar ches lhag pa'i mchod pa dang / slong (4)mo bza' bar bya ste grub bo zhes pa'i tshig 'don par byed do/ /mar gyi sreg (5 blugs stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg byas pas pha rol zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /cho 'phrul gyi phyogs la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la dri dang me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa de bzhin du phul nas dung gi me tog can gyi me tog stong phrag brgya la i gu ta'i til mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ grong dang / grong khyer dang / ljongs dang /glang po che dang / rta dang / ba lang dang / ma he rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /de nas yang pra dbab par byed par 'dod na mtshan mo bdun du 'o ma dang nas zan bza' zhing mtshan mo gcig 6tu gso sbyong dang ldan pas dri ma med pa'i mar gyis 7 lhud de 8bkang nas dkar po'i mar sar gyis mar me sbar nas gzhon nu'am gzhon nu ma la bstan par bya'o/ /de nyid du ras ris bzhugs nas ku sha bting ba la nyal bar bya'o/ /rmi lam du rdzas stong phrag nyi shu mthong ngo cha phyed dkon mchog gsum la sbyar bar bya'o zhes so/ /ras ris kyi spyan sngar dkar po'i tshes gcig 9nas brtsams te ji srid zla ba nya'i bar du nyi ma re re la 94—116

sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /dri dang me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa rnams kyis 0)mchod par bya'o/ /mthar mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs spyad de rig pa bzlas par byas la/ cho 'phrul gyi phyogs nas lam po cher song la 'byung po'i brang (nadu gnas par bya'o/ /rab tu stsol cig ces brjod par bya'o/ /yungs kur bre ru blangs nas lan nyi shu rtsa gcig satu mngon par bsngags nas phyogs bcu dang 'og tu gtor bar bya'o/ /mchog bdag nyid la ston par byed de/ de bzhin du nag po'i brgyad pa la dri gtsang khang du zhugs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar rig pa stong du bzlas par bya'o//dri dang me tog la sogs pa dang / gtor ma'i cho ga byas nas de nas rmi lam du bcom ldan 'das ral pa'i cod pan byas pa mthong bar byed do/ /sa ga'i zla ba dkar po'i phyogs la 'o ma dang nas zan za 4zhing ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la dri dang me tog la sogs pas mchod pa byas nas nyi ma re re la ston mo bya'o/ /chus gang ba'i bum pa bzhi sman dang sa bon thams cad kyis yongs su bkang ba byas nas gzhag (5par bya'o/ /mtshan mo re re la stong phrag brgyad du mngon par bsngags par byas nas bya rog gi tshang du bu 65byung gi bar khye'u dang bu mo bkru bar bya'o/ /rgyal srid kyi don nam/ longs 7spyod kyi don zla ba phyed kyi nang du 'grub bo// //nag po'i brgyad pa la bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas dri dang me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa dbul bar byas nas 'o ma can gyi shing gi yam shing gis na me sbar te me tog brgya pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /zla ba gcig 9tu bza' ba dang btung ba mi zad pa 'byung ngo / /dur khrod kyi thal ba blangs 94—117

nas lan bdun mngon par bzlas te bdag nyid kyi dpral ba'am/ gzhan gyi mgo bor btab par byas nas grong du zhugs na thams cad dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bzlas pas 'ching ba las 1grol bar byed do/ /gtan pa gcog par byed do/ /lpags bdun nyams par byed do/ /mā li na ka'i me tog la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgya bya'o/ /ba lang gi gcin dang nas zan za zhing zla ba drug tu 'dod pa bzhin du dong tse rnyed do/ /dkar po'i tshes gcig rinas brtsams te ut+pal sngon po'i snying po 5)sbyin sreg stong bya ste/ming nas smos te nyi ma bdun la dbang du 'gyur ro/ /tsam pa ka dang / kuṇ+ḍa ka yis 'dus gsum du sbyin sreg bya zhing / ming nas smos na gang 'dod pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /cho 'phrul gyi phyogs la 'o ma dang nas zan za zhing dus gsum du stong phrag brgyad du bzlas pa dang / ras ris kyi spyan sngar a ga ru'i yam shing gis 'bum phrag gsum du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /bcwa 7lnga la sgrub pa la rab tu 'jug ste ji srid bcom ldan 'das byon pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /sa g.yo ba'am mar me'i rtse mo 'phel ba'am ras ris g.yo bar byed pa dang grub bo / /grub bo zhes tshig 'don par byed na rgyal srid dam yul gyi bdag po nyid rnyed do/ /sngon spyad pa byas pas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar zla ba drug gi nang du stong phrag lnga so sor rnyed do/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la mchod pa byas nas stong phrag brgya bzlas par byas te dngul stong rnyed do/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten la stong phrag brgya bzlas par bya'o/ /'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin par 'gyur ro/ /nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'dod pas 94—118

gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i srad bu la stong phrag brgyad mngon par bsngags par byas nas blangs nas bskor bar 1bya ste/ skal ba bzang po nyid rnyed do/ /rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung du zhugs nas til nag po la stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya ste srad bu can dang til dang sol ba nyid do/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du dkar po'i tshes gcig nanas brtsams nas bcwa lnga la mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas u dum bā 4ra'i shing gis me sbar nas yungs 5kur dkar po la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgya bya'o/ /yul gru lnga'i dpon por 'gyur ro/ /byang chub shing gi yam shing gis phyirame sbar nas/ til la zho dang mar dang sbrang rtsis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgya bya'o/ /bcwa 7lnga la mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pa byas nas gal te til de rnams phyogs dang phyogs bral du song na de'i tshe grub pa yin te sems can thams cad dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar sngon du stong phrag brgya bzlas te zla ba gzas bzung ba na til mar lan bdun cu phul nas ji srid lbu ba 'byung ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /'thungs na 8thos pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /kun tu ru ka 9la stong phrag brgyad khobazlas nas 11blangs na 1 grong gcig 1 rnyed do/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar nyi ma so sor brgyad brgyar bzlas par bya ste dpal dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /a pā marga'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags te nyi ma so sor sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na grong rnyed do / /bu mang po can gyi yam shing la me sbar nas shu dag stong phrag brgyad du sbyin sreg bya'o/ /thal ba des thig le bya'o/ /mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma 94—119

gyur na lan gsum du yang bsgrub par bya'o/ /zla ba gzas bzung ba na chu klung gi 'gram du song nas bil ba'i yam shing gis me sbar nas bil ba'i me tog la mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgya byas na gnod sbyin gzhon nu 'ong bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo byed (1na rig pa stong phrag bzlas nas de nas gcig (na'ong bar byed de/ gter rnams sam/ nor gyi bdag po gang tshig gis brjod de byed do/ /nag po'i brgyad pa la bcom ldan 'das la dri dang me tog dang bdug pa la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod pa 5)byas nas nag po'i bcu bzhi pa la gtor ma'i cho ga bya ste rig pa stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya'o/ /sha za rnams 'ong bar byed do/ /gter rkos ri shig ces brjod par bya'o/ /de nas gter stsol bar byed de blangs nas bdag nyid dkon mchog gsum po rnams la dbul bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du ras ris bcing ba'i las kyang bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ba ru ra'i shing gis me sbar nas/ nyi ma so sor til dang 'bras thug po che'i sbyin sreg stong bya'o/ /blon po dbang du byed pa la yungs kur dkar po'i sbyin sreg gis dbang du 'gyur ro/ /sra rtsi pog gi sbyin sreg gis rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /bud med dang skyes pa dbang du byed pa la phub ma'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o / /a ru ra'i shing gis me sbar nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar nyi ma so sor sgron shing gis sbyin sreg stong bya ste dong tse 5brgya rnyed do/ /slong 6mo za bas nyi ma so sor dus gsum du pa 7lha sha'i sbyin sreg bya ste/ gser brgya so sor rnyed do / /rgya mtshor song nas rig pa stong phrag brgya bzla ste/ ji srid rin po che rnams sbyin par byed do/ /blang bar bya ste dkon mchog gsum la nges par sbyar bar bya'o/ /sngags 'di nyid kyis sa ga'i zla ba nya ba la mtshan thog thag tu bzlas 94—120

pa bar ma chad pa brjod par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi shing drung du bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas a pā marga'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi 1dang mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /bdag nyid ston pa yungs kur gyis grol bar 'gyur ro/ /zhi bar 'dod na 'bras yos kyi sreg /blugs kyis sbyin sreg brgyad brgya byas na zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyas par 'dod na 'o ma can gyi yam shing gis me sbar nas til dang 'bras thug po ches thun gsum du sbyin sreg brgyad brgyar bya'o/ /nyi ma gsum du a mra'i yam shing gis me sbar nas dur bha dang tsher ma can gyi rasbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /rtsod par ci'adod pa rnams kyi (5)smra ba'i mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /nyi ma so sor 'bru rlon pa dang / phub ma rnams lag pa g.yon pas sbyin sreg byas nas 6ming nas smos na 7mtshan mo bdun gyis dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i yam shing gis me sbar nas til dang 'bras thug po che'i sbyin sreg thun mtshams gsum du stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /nyi ma gsum du a mra'i yam shing gis me sbar nas dur bha dang tsher ma can gyi sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /nyi ma bdun gyis skyes bu chen po rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'o ma dang ba lang gi gcin dang nas zan dang bsod snyoms za ba'am mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs kun tu spyad cing gtsang mas gos gtsang ma dang shing shun 'chang 78bas sgrub 9 pa byas te/ gang gar 1 gtun shing gi sgra dang bral ba gtsang ma'i phyogs su chu bo'i 'gram gnyis kyi sa blangs nas khru bdun pa'i sa'i gong bu bzhi byas nas dbus su 'dab ma stong gi pad+ma byas te/ de'i steng du bde bar gshegs pa'i mtho gang gi tshad kyi lcags lnga las byas pa'i 'khor lo rab tu bzhag nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bris sku'i spyan sngar bsgrub par bya'o/ /dri 94—121

zhim po'i dri rnams dang tsan+dan dkar dmar gyis mchod nas mas ra ba'i (17me tog dang / bdug pa dang phreng ba brgya phul nas bcom rinaldan 'das la dri dang /me tog dang / bdug pa la sogs pa'i mchod pa bya'o/ /mar gyi mar me'i phreng ba bdun dbul bar bya'o/ /phyogs bzhir mar gyi bum pa bzhi rab tu sbar bar bya'o / /phyogs bzhir bum pa bzhi sa bon thams cad kyis gang bar rin po che rnams bcug nas gzhag na par bya'o/ /a ga ru dang / kun du ru ka ri dang /dpal rnams btags pa dang / gu gul gyi bdug pa dbul bar bya'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga byas nas phyogs bzhir sngar brjod pas 5zho zan sngon ma can dbul bar bya'o/ /lho ru ni na 'byu tak+ta ra dar ba chu dang bsres pa sbyin par bya'o/ /byang phyogs su 'o thug gis gang ba'i gtor mas nye bar mchod par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la phyogs bzhir rgyun mi 'chad pa 'byung bar bya'o/ / pa lā 7sha'i yam shing gis me sbar nas a pā marga'i yam shing la mar gyis btags la lan bdun mngon par bsngags te/ sbyin sreg brgyad brgya bya'o/ /ming nas smos pa de dbang du 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yam shing gis me sbar nas lan tshwa las byung ba'i gzugs brnyan byas te/ mgo bo nas brtsams te ji srid rkang pa'i bar du sreg /blugs re re la lan bdun bdun mngon par bsngags pa byas nas sreg (blugs stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /ming nas smos pa'i rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro / /dkar po'i bcwa 1 lnga la yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong can gyis nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas te/ sa la ma lhung ba'i ba byung gis ba lang gi pags 11pa'i tshad kyi 12dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten dang / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi zhabs kyi 94—122

drung du gser dngul gyi snod du ser skyar rgyud mtshungs pa'i ba'i mar gzhon nu mas bsrubs pa blangs nas ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste1/ lag pa g.yon pas snod bzung lag pa g.yas pa'i ming med kyi sor mos dkrug par bya ste/ ji srid dro bar gyur pa de srid du'o/ /de nas btung bar bya ste/ yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig na brjod pas thos pa 'dzin par byed do/ /de la du ba 'thul bas ni dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /'bar bas ni mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /yan lag thams cad na ba nye bar zhi bar 'dod pas dkar po'i brgyad pa la gso sbyong can gyis snga dro las brtsam dpar bya'o/ /shar la sogs pa'i phyogs su gzhu'i tshad kyi dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs nas dbus su nad pa'i so phag gzhag rigapar bya'o/ /phyogs bzhi rnams su bum pa chus gang ba bzhi la brgyad brgyar mngon par bzlas la gzhag 5par bya'o/ /so phag rnams kyi steng du sen rtsi'i gos gzhag 6par bya'o/ /gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i tshon sna lnga'i skud pas yongs su dkris te dri zhim pos yongs su bkang bas so/ /phyi rol du dkyil 'khor bya'o/ /phyogs bzhir chang dang sha'i gtor ma dbul 7lo/ /dri zhim po'i me tog gis mchod pa byas nas gu gul gyi dud pa dbul lo/ /zangs kyi snod mar gyis bkang ba gzhag 8par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha ljang gu 9bzung nas nad pa gos dkar mo can la ji srid rkang pa'i bar du byab par bya'o/ /mar gyi steng du ku sha dor bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /de nas mar zos pas blta bar bya'o/ /de nas ku sha ljang gu 1 blangs nas chos bzhin du gzhag 11par bya'o / /sbyangs pa las 'byung ba'i snod dang gos byas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi zhabs la phyag byed du gzhug 15go/ /de nas pri 94—123

yaṅku dang / nā ༅7ga ge sar dang / sbrang rtsi can dang / bzhi po gcig ༷ notu byas nas mnyam par thob par byas la mar dang lhan cig pa'i zas mchog zos na nad med pa rang bzhin du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /skud pa sngon po la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa byas nas rked pa la bcing bar bya'o/ /shu ba mched pa nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /de bzhin du mgrin pa la nye bar bcing bar bya'o / /dbugs mi bde ba nye bar zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /gso sbyong can gyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs nas dri bzang po'i me tog rnams kyis mchod pa byas te mar gyi mar me dbul lo/ /de nas byang chub shing gi 4yam shing gis me rab tu sbar ro/ /sbar nas sra 5ci pog la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i sreg 6〉blugs stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg bya'o/ /nad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /rig pas bgegs nye bar zhi bar byed/ 'dod pas rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung gi 'gram gnyis kyi sa blangs nas seng ge dang / stag dang / phag dang / lug gi gdong pa la sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs pa nyi shu rtsa gcig lhag pa'i brgya bya'o/ /de nas nag po'i brgyad pa la gso sbyong can gyis mtshan mo phyogs gtsang mar bla re dmar po bres la las yang dag par brtsam mo/ /sen rtsi'i gos bcu bzhi la bgegs gzhag 7par bya'o/ /dbus su bgegs rnams kyi na gtso bo log 'dren gzhag dulapar bya'o/ /tshon sna lnga'i phye ma la lan cig 1 mngon par bsngags pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor bdun bya'o/ /dri dmar po'i me tog rnams kyis 11mngon par mchod pa byas nas mar gyi mar me bcu bzhi dbul lo/ /gu gul gyi bdug pa dbul lo/ /sha dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bcu bzhi dbul lo/ /rgya skyegs kyi khu 94—124

ba yang bcu bzhi gtor bar bya'o/ /de nas srad bu dmar po la 1rilan bdun mngon par bsngags pas mtshan ma bcing bar bya'o/ /'byung po dang /bgegs kyi rgyal po yang bcing bar bya'o/ /de nas u dum bā 2ra'i yam shing gis me sbar nas bgegs rnams bcing bar bya'o zhes brjod de/ swā hā'i noyi shes dkyil 'khor ba rnams la sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /der bgegs dang log par 'dren pa bcings par 'gyur ro/ /rig pa rnams thams cad sgrub par byed pa na bgegs rnams 'phrul byed do/ /des can bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams sa'i snod gcig 5tu bgegs thams cad gzhug par bya'o/ /gcig (65tu log par 'dren pa chen po'o/ /de nas bgegs rnams thams cad la me tog thams cad dbul bar bya zhing log par 'dren pa chen po la tsan+dan dmar po dang / ka ra bī ri ra'i me tog dmar po dbul lo/ /bgegs rnams thams cad la rdzas thams cad kyi bdug pa dbul lo/ /log par 'dren pa chen po la gu gul gyi bdug pa dbul lo/ /mar dang bsres 8pa dbul lo/ /de nas lte ba'i tshad kyi dong du so sor gzhug par bya'o/ /de lta bus bgegs thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /gso sbyong can gyis 9dkar po'i bcwa 1 lnga la ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du sa la ma lhung ba'i ba lang gi lci bas dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs pa byas nas me tog dang dri dang bdug pa 11mar gyi me la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod pa byas nas u dum bā 1 ra'i shing gis me sbar nas tshangs ma'i yam shing gis 1 sbyin sreg bya zhing / lha la phul ba zos na yid gzhungs par 'gyur ro/ /'o ma'i sbyin sreg byas na bram ze rnams dbang du 'gyur ro/ /lha la phul ba'i sbyin sreg byas na rgyal rigs dbang du 'gyur ro/ /nas dang / zho 94—125

dang / lha la phul ba gcig ga1)tu byas nas sbyin sreg byas na rje rigs dbang du 'gyur ro/ /dgra 2la bltas nas bzlas pa byas na rengs par 'gyur ro/ /lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i chus thams cad 'bebs pa dang nor byed do/ /dug thams cad la yang nye bar byug go/ /zhun mkhan gyi ril bu byas nas lan bdun mngon par bsngags pas mig nad sel bar byed do/ /na ba la skud pa bcing bar bya ste/ gdon thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /gtsug phud bcings pas bdag nyid srung ba'o/ /thal bas dkyil 'khor bcings pa'o bong ba la lan bdun bzlas pas phyogs bcings pa'o ri/ /bud med bu ma thon pa la til la yongs su bzlas nas sbyin par bya ste/ bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /rmongs pas mngal gyi zla mtshan gyi dus las 'das pa na khrus bya zhing rgyud mtshungs pa'i 'o ma la brgya rtsa brgyad mngon par bsngags pa byas nas btung bar sbyin zhing bza' ba mchog dang mar bsres pa bza' bar bya'o/ /de nas bu btsa' bar 'gyur ro/ /bu mang po can gyi sbyin sreg brgya rtsa brgyad bya'o/ /thal ba re 5richu'i bum pa bzhi dang kun tu bsres nas gzhag 6par bya'o/ /shu dag la lan brgyad brgyar bzlas te lag pa g.yas pa la bcings pas 7ji srid smra ba thams cad kyi mchog tu 'gyur ro/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i me tog gis sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad byas na g.yul du gzhan gyis mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /gzhon nu mas bkal ba'i skud pa la mdud pa byas te lan bdun mngon par bsngags nas lag pa bcing bar bya'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dug 8mi 'byung ngo / /de nas ma rungs pas mche ba'i ming nas smos te chu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags nas khyor chu 'thungs pas de lta bus shi ba yang ldang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du bcu 94—126

bzhi ru mngon par bsngags par byas nas btung ba sbyin par bya'o/ /'jog pos kyang mche ba sos par bya'o/ /chang gi phabs la lan bdun mngon par bsngags 37pa byas nas shi ba la sbyin par bya'o/ /gal te byis pa mi 'byung ngo / /de nas sems dpa' chen pos slar yang rig pa thams cad yang dag par skul 2bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas sgrub pa'i thabs kyi spyi'i rig pa gsungs so/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ri dzu ke/ tā re/ shārnye/ tut+ta re/ a na bhi/sā le/ tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma spyi bo'i sgrol ma zhes bya'o/ /rig pa 'dis rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung du phrag pa'i tshad kyis chur zhugs nas rig pa stong phrag brgya bzlas par bya ste/ ji srid nam mkha' nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la bug pa mthong ba'i bar du ste/ de lta bu byas pas las 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /gal te ma mthong na slar yang bsgrub par bya'o/ /de nas lan bdun du mar rjes su song nas dri dang me tog dang bdug pa dang gtor ma'i cho ga bya ste/ lag pa g.yas pas mnan nas mtshan thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /ji srid dbugs 'byin no zhes brjod nga 'i bar du'o/ /nyi ma so sor dngul brgya sbyin par byed de/ de yang zad par bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a cab lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 5ru ṇi kā ya/ ri 'dzu ke / tā re/ shārnye/ tā re/ a na bhi/ lā mye tut+ta re/ a gra/ dharma ni t+yā te / tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma dag pa zhes bya ba ste/ rig pa 94—127

'dis dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba zho dang / sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /dus gsum du ba lang brgya rnyed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya / ma hā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ lam+bi/ pra lam+bi/ lam+bi bīr+ya/ sarba sin+titshe ku ru swā hā / 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma 'phyang ba zhes bya ba ste/ rig pa 'dis ka ra bī (1)ra'i yam shing la mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya ste/ ji srid rgyal po dbang du 'gyur te 'ong bar byed do/ /sde snod smra ba yang sgo rin ba'i las byas pa 'ching ba grol ba la sogs pa de yang sbyong du 'jug go/ /de ma grol bar du mang du dngos grub thams cad kyi ri 5grub pa yang sngar brjod pa'i rig ④pas / sarba sid+dhiñtsa/ me ku ru swā hā/ zhes byin nas rtag tu bzlas pas 'ching ba grol bar byed do/ /yang na gtsang mar gyur pas mtshan thog thag bzlas par bya ste 'ching ba grol bar byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki 5te shwa rā ya/bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ri dzu 16ri /dharme/ tā re/ shān+ta dharma tut+ta re a na bi 7la phye/ dharme tu re swā hā/ 'di nani 'phags ma sgrol ma ku9rizhi ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ 'dis ma du lusga 1 dang / dhā lan dang / sog ma'i me la sbyin sreg bya ste/ ji srid log 'dren 'ong bar byed de/ de brjod par bya'o/ /nyi ma so sor bdag la dong tse 11re sbyin no/ /de yang zad par bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la reg tu gzhug par bya'o/ /de nas grub par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa gzhan du na mi sdod do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo 94—128

dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ri dzu ka /dharma ni t+yā te/ tā re shān+ta77/ dharma ni t+yā te tut+ta re a na bhi lā phye/ dharma ni t+yā ten/ tu re swā hā/ 'di 5ni 'phags ma sgrol ma drang po zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ 'dis ring bsrel di dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du be shaṅka ta'i yam shing gis me sbar nas bil ba'i 'bras bu la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /'dis las rnams dpal dang ldan pa'am yul gyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo snye.a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te 'chisamyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a gra 7ridharma ni t+yā tā ra(8ri/ ri dzu ka 9 dharma ni t+yā 〉te/ tut+ta re/ a na dhī /kālā phye/ dharma ni t+yā te tā re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog ces bya ba'i rig pa ste/'dis rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i chu klung du zhugs te/ ki ki rā ṅgā'i 12me tog sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /nyi ma so so'am nyin zhag la tshal bdun nam brgyad rnyed do / /yang na dngul brgya mthong ngo / /rig pa de nyid kyis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi spyan sngar 'o ma can gyi shing gis 15me sbar nas mar gyi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /dpal dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma nga.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ a gre tā re/ ri dzu ke tā re/shārnye tut+ta re/ a na bhi bolha phye/ tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma mngon par rjod tshapar byed ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ 'di rtag tu bzlas pas nad med par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi 94—129

satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a gre tā re/ a na bhi lā phye/ dharma tut+ta re/ a na bhi lā phye/ dharma nir+sā 1te tu re swā hā/ 'di rin)ni 'phags ma sgrol ma nges par 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas 'dod pa nye bar rdzogs par byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ a gre tā re/ ri dzu ka dharma tut+ta re/ a na bhi/ lā mye/ dharme tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma mngon par brjod pa byar med pa'i chos zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas dgra thams cad las mchog tu rgyal bar byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki 45te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ma hā satā ya/ a gre tā re/ shārnye dharme tut+ta re/ shān+ta dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/'di zhi ba'i chos nges par 'byung ma'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du thob par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya / ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma hā kā 55ru ṇi kā ya/ a gre tā re/ ri dzu ka 'adharma/ nir+sā te/ tut+ta re/ a na bhi lā mye dharma nir+sā te/ tut+ta re swā hā/'di ni drang po can gyi 7chos kyi mchog nges par 'byung ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas don thams cad thob pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ma'am/ rin po che rnyed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakli bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a gre tā re/ ri dzu ke dharma nir+sā te tut+ta re ri dzu ka 8༷dharma nir+sā te tut+ta 94—130

re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma thams cad drang po zhes bya ba'i 1rig pa ste rtag tu bzlas pas skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma na.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a gre dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā / 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma phongs pa las /sgrol ba'i mchog ces bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas skye ba rgyun mi 'chad par byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a gre tā re/a na bhi lā phye tā re/ a na bhi 4lnga mye tut+ta re/ a na bhi lā gye dharma nir+sā 5te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma mchog ces bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas mchog gi 'bras bu ster ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya / ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ shārnye dharme tut+ta re shān+ta tsidharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma zhi ba ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas zhi ba'i sems skyed 7par byed don/ /na ma 9rat+na tra 1 yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ri dzu ke tā re/ ri dzu ka dharma tut+tha re ri dzu ka dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma drang por ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas drang po'i sems skyed 11par byed do/ /chos thams cad ces 1 bya ba'i rig pa 'di rnams bklags pas 'grub pa/ bdag nyid srung ba dang / gzhan srung ba dang / bde ba thams 94—131

cad sbyin pa/ 'bum phrag gcig brjod pas sngar brjod pa'i las thams cad bsgrub par bya ste stong phrag bcu bzlas pas bsod nams 'phel bar byed pa/stong phrag sum cu bzlas pas bsod nams dang ldan pa/ 'bum phrag gsum bzlas na 1mtshams med pa byas pas kyang 'grub par 'gyur te/ mdor na ma nor bar phan pa sgrub pa'i sems sbyin pa snying rje'i bdag nyid can yang rtag tu bzlas pas nad thams cad med par 'gyur ro/ /yams thams cad mi 'byung ngo / /nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes de bzhin du rtogs napar bya'o/ /de nas 'di'i cho ga phyogs tsam du 'gyur te/ 'bum bzlas pas las thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gnyis bzlas pas sdig pa zad par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas mchog rnams sgrub par byed do/ /'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pas mngon par shes pa so sor rnyed do/ /'bum phrag lnga bzlas pas lha'i shes pa so sor rnyed do/ /'bum phrag drug bzlas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rnyed do/ /'bum phrag bdun bzlas pas mngon par shes pa lngar 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag bcu bzlas pas rgyal srid chen po so sor rnyed do/ /'bum phrag bcu gcig bzlas pas rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de nas mig sman ldong ros a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma bdun gyi nang du btums te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar ji srid dro ba dang / du ba 'thul ba dang / 'bar ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de la dro bar gyur pas ni dbang du byed do/ /du ba 'thul bas ni mi snang ba'o/ /'bar bas ni nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /mar gyi sreg tsho blugs 'bum sbyin sreg byas na gang 'dod pa de sbyin par byed do/ /'bum phrag bcu gsum bzlas par bya ste 'phags pa 94—132

spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mthong ngo / /de mthong nas gang tshol ba de rnyed do//tsan+dan dkar po'i nyu༄yam shing gis sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /tshig gam zhabs 'ching ba thob cing yul gyi bdag por 'gyur ro/ /a ga ru nag po'i yam shing gis sbyin sreg 'bum bya'o/ /rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rgya chen po rnyed do / /tsan+dan dmar po'i yam shing gis sbyin sreg 'bum byan/ grub pa thams cad la stong phrag bsdus pa rnyed do/ /byang chub shing gi 'og tu 'bum phrag bdun bzlas par bya'o/ /bcu na dang bcud kyis len rnams rnyed do/ /zos pas skra dkar dang gnyer ma spangs par 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu bzlas pas bya rgod sel bar byed do/ /'bum phrag gnyis bzlas pas rgyal po'i btsun mo mchog dang rnam par 'phrul bar byed do/ /yungs kur 4rgyal pos rtag tu sbyin sreg byas na rgyal po dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'di la mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg bya'o/ /rtag tu nor rnyed do/ /gso sbyong can gyis 'bum bzlas par bya'o/ /bza' ba dang btung ba zhim po 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /arga'i yam shing gis sbyin sreg 'bum bya'o / /gser brgya rnyed do/ /pi rgya kai gi sbyin sreg bya'o/ /skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /yid la byas nas sgrubazlas pa bya ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas nad thams cad dang / gdon thams cad dang / gdung ba thams cad dang /nye bar 'tshe ba dang / 'jigs pa thams cad 'joms par byed do/ /gu gul gyi ril bu la mar gyis btags pa'i sbyin sreg stong phrag brgyad bya'o/ /nor 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gsum gyis rgyal srid rnyed do/ /rgyu skar gyis gnod pa la 'o ma dang phan tshun bsres pa'i zho'i sbyin sreg bya ste zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag nyid dam gzhan gyis sna ma'i me tog gi 6sbyin sreg gis rgyal 94—133

po dbang du byed par 'gyur ro/ /drur 91ba'i myu gus sbyin sreg bya ste zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bdag dang gzhan gyi (2)rgyas par 'dod na til dang 'bras thug po che'i sbyin sreg bya ste da nor chen po thob par 'gyur ro/ /bā la dang so so la ka la brgyad brgyar mngon par bsngags pa byas nas 'byung po'i nye bar 'tshe bas btab pa'i sems can thams cad la ston du gzhug par bya'o/ /mthong ba la rang caganas 'gro'o/ /mig la brgyad brgyar bzlas na dang po gang mthong ba de dag tu 'gyur ro/ /chu la yongs su bzlas nas gdong bkru bar bya ste/ skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro/ /bya rog ma 'phur ba la rtag tu bzlas pas gang 'dod pa de rnyed do/ /chu la lan bdun mngon par bsngags pa'i khyor chu nyi ma so sor tho rangs btung bar bya'o/ /nad med par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bud med dbang du bya bar 'dod pas/ lan tshwa las byas pa'i gzugs brnyan byas nas/ rkang pa g.yon pas mnan te spyi bor stong phrag brgyad bzlas par bya ste nyi ma bdun gyis 5dbang du 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa sgrub thabs kyi grub pa dang /yid la grub pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa 'di rnams sad pa'i rgyur yang rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /de bzhin du yang 'dir phyogs cung zad tsam zhig byas pa las sgrub thabs kyis nye bar sbyor ba'i khyad par gyi stobs su 'gyur bar bya'o/ /tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs tsam gyis/ /sgrub pa'i yang dag dngos grub spyod/ /shin tu stong min gang ba min/ /bza' ba kun nas sbyin par bya/ /tsha ba mngar skyur la sogs pa'i/ /ro las yul bral lnga la yang / /sred tsho0pa ldan pas ro la (7ni / /srid pa gang phyir skye bar 'gyur/ /srid pas bzlas dang sbyin sreg sogs/ /'dir ni cung zad brtsam mi bya/ /'dir spro 'dir ni rnam par shes/ /lag pa 94—134

ldag la sogs brjod pa/ /dor bar bya 'am dor bya min/ /nang du g.yog po lha rnams ni/ /phur bu gnas par yongs brtag bya/ /lha rnams kyi ni khang pa 'am//khang stong dang ni phug gi nang / /shing gcig 1gam ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni tshang tshing du/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg sgrub pa yang / /rtse gcig yid kyis bya ba yin/ /ma dag ma dag kun dag la/ /dag pa rnam par sbyong ba yin/ /gnyis ka yis kyang gnyis ka la/ /dngos grub smra bas bsgrub par bya/ /gang yang ro yi srad bu dang / /lhag ma de nas 'gongs pa dang / /zla mtshan ldan pas kun tu reg /gdol pa'i skye bos bskal ba yang / /rul pa'i dri dang slar yang 'byung / /legs byas 'dod pas sbyin par bya/ /lha rnams tshad (2du bsnyen pa las/ /de lta la sogs yon tan ldan/ /zas sam mal stan la sogs pa/ /sgrub po nanorang gis blangs pa'am/ /min pa nyid ni bsnyen par bya/ /btung ba ldan pas gnas dang dga'/ /skye bo ngan pa'i sems can bcas/ /phyi can kun tu btags pas blangs/ /mtshams med lnga po byed pa po/ /nad dang 'byung chen byed pa dang / /med pa'am yang na 5mang na yang ne/ /zas dang le los bcom pa dang / /dge 'dun 'khu dang ngo tsha med/ /ser sna lhur len mtshon 7gyis 'bugs/ /rtag tu log par lta ba gzhan/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan / /kun tu gsungs pa mdzes pa'o/ /dus min khrus ni mi nus na'ang 8/ /rang gis 9rinas pa ma yin pa/ /rang gi rlung ni mchog tu bsgrags/ /dus gsum min par de yod pa/ /gcig 7tu theg gsum bral ba dang / /khrus nyes pa dang chu bo'i nang / /nyes pa gsum zhes bya ba 'joms/ /khrus ni mchog tu rab tu bsgrags/ /de phyir dus kyang kun bsams nas/ /me des sam ni de 94—135

nas kyang / /chu yis khrus ni dngos grub kun/ /sgrub pa po la bstan pa yin/ /de nas kun tu nad pa las/ /gsang ba'i sngags kyis khrus rnams ni/ /rab tu bsgrags 1par gyur pa nayin/ /yang 'dir sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ bud+dhā shu tsi/dharma shu tsi/ saṃ gha shu tsi/ a ne na par+ya/ bā kye na/ a shu tsi shu tsi ra/ bha bā mi swā hā/ sngags 'dis chu la lan cig riyongs su bzlas nas bkru bar bya'o/ /sngon du bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa'i dus su dang / nad pa la dzo nisngags 'dis khrus byas pas gtsang mar 'gyur ro/ /mtshan mo'i stod du thun gsum du dam pa'i chos kyi kha ton la sogs pa rnams kyis 5dub pas mtshan mo'i gung la ku sha la sogs pa'i stan la gtsang sbra dang srung ba'i cho ga dang phyag rgyas yongs su brtags te sgrub 6pa'i thabs kyi cho ga bya'o/ /de'i tshe sung ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /seng ge'i mal du sgrub pa pos rtag tu seng ge'i stabs kyis 7rilho'am shar gyi phyogs su mgo bo bstan nas rmi lam du me zhi ba can nam rgyas pa can gyi sbyin sreg gal te gyur na shar dang / lho'i lho ru kun tu gnas nas rkang pa rab tu brkyang 58)bar bya'o / /nub kyi phyogs su mgo bo byas nas lho'i phyogs su kha bltas la nyal bar bya'o / /rig pa rnams dang yang dag par ldan pas gang yang tsan+dan dang /bil ba la sogs pa dang / n+ya gro dha dang / u dum bā 9skur la sogs pa rmi lam du 1 mthong na/ bdag nyid yang dag par 'phags pa'i dngos grub kyi mtshan ma'o / /ngang pa dang / bya kā 11raṇ+ḍa ba dang / khrung khrung dang / rma bya dang /bya ro ha na rmi lam du byung na de'i dngos grub myur du bdag la 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /gos dkar po dang mnyam par kun tu ston pa 'di yang bdag nyid kyang tshe 94—136

'phel bar mthong na gdon mi za bar dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal mtshan gyi phreng bas khyab pa dang / rmi lam du khang bzangs 1la 'dzeg (na pa'am/mnan pa la sogs pa byung na dngos grub kyi mtshan nyid de/ gru la mngon par 'dzegs pa dang / de bzhin du de'i pi wang 'dzin pa'o/ /rgyal mtshan dang ba dan (8)la sogs pa rmi lam du reg pa byung ba dang / chu 4cig til mar gyis reg pa yang dag grub pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /rmi lam du bong bu dang / rnga mo dang /shing rta la sogs pa rnams mthong ba'am/ rig 5pa la sogs pa ni dngos grub la bar du gcod par shes par bya'o/ /nges par yang 'dod do/ /de la sogs pa'i yon tan ldan/ /dge ba'i las dang dge las gzhan/ /de rnams thams cad sgrub pa ni/ /de phyir rmi lam shes nas bya/ /rmi lam srung dang phyag rgya ni/ /phan tshun nyid du rig pa 'dzin/ /bgegs rnams rtag tu gnyid log byed/ /rnam par gzhom bya rnam ne 'joms pa/ /yang dag nyer 7gnas de yi phyir/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg la sogs kun/ sngar brjod bsrung ba sbyar bar bya/ /srung ba'i cho ga'i dbye ba las/ /de 'dis yang dag 'grub par 'dod/ /mkha' la rgyu ba'i lha gnod sbyin/ /rang grub yi dgas 2srin po dang / /kun tu rgyu byed rnam 9'joms phyir/ /rang gi gnas dang sems kun g.yo/ /de phyir thog sam nas bya ba/ /bdag nyid srung dang mtshan ma ni/ /nye bar mtshon pa la sogs pa / /sgrub pa kun gyi tshe na 'gyur/ /mtshan ma med par gyur na ni/ /bgegs de las 'bras skye ba la/ /khyi ni g.yon nas 'byin pa dang / /ba lang sbyin dang mdzes pa yi/ /'dab brgya can dang rna ba can/ /ri dgas 11ce spyang bya rog dang / /khyim gyi phag pa de bzhin nyid/ /rtsangs pa gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 94—137

dang / /ba dan la sogs thams cad nas/ /gtso bor brjod bya dge ba'o/ /dge ba la sogs rig pa yis/ /mi dge ba yi mi dge la/ /de bzhin mchog dang mchog min dbye/ /shes nas dang por spyad par bya/ /bil ba arga'i me tog ni/ /min nyid 'dod dang a ram pa/ /khyad par las ni de byin cig /blo ldan sngags pas las kun la/ /me thab rnam pa gsum bya'o/ /lho ru mngon par kha phyogs par/ /gyur pa'i hūm̐ phaṭa yi ge ni/ /swā hā'i gnas su gzhag —17par bya/ /yid kyis kun tu bsams nas bya/ /mngon spyod can gyis tshonacho ga bya/ /byang du mngon par phyogs gyur nas/ /swā hā'i yi ge dang ldan bzlas/ /yid kyis bsams nas zhi ba bya/ /dge ba mngon par mdzes pa can/ /shar du kha bltas 5nyid kyis bya/ /zhi ba can dang rgyas pa can/ /bye brag tu ni brjod bya ste / /'og tu kha bltas 4byas nas kyang / /rgyas pa nyid la rab sbyar bya/ /mngon spyod stan la skyil krung ste/ /zhi dang rgyas pa can brjod pa'ang / /rang gi stan la tsog pur brjod/ /mi dge'i las kyi kun spyod ni/ /skra dang sen mor brjod pa ni/ /bcing bar mi bya gang gi phyir/ /gal te sgrub po tshangs spyod dang / /ldan gyur de tshe nyes pa med/ /bzlas dang sbyin sreg sogs bya la/ /'thab mo 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /yongs su dag par bya bzhin pa'i/ /skra rnams mkhas pas tshul de nyid/ /spu gris skra ni breg par bya/ /bsags 5par bya ba yang ma yin/ /dngos grub 'dod pas gnas pa ni/ /lha rnams mchod par yongs su bsgrags/ /'dod pa'ang min yang stobs bsags pa/ /de nyid phyir yang nyes bcas 'gyur/ /sen mo'ang yongs su 'chang ba dang / /de bzhin so dang spu la sogs/ /dri ma nyid ni bcang mi bya/ /shig la sogs pa 94—138

rab skyes pa/ /de las sro ma la sogs 'byung / /khron pa de ni blta mi bya/ /snang byed gzas tsho1zin gnas pa na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg pa ni/ /dngos grub 'dod pas nyams mi bya/ /lha rnams mchod pa'i dus su yang / /zas mngon ma gyur lha rnams la/ /shes rab can gyis namachod mi bya/ /gal te gzhan du bla ma'i bka' no/ /dam tshig las ni bzlas par 'gyur/ /sngon dus chos rnams thams cad ni/ /nyan pa sogs kyis mchod par 'gyur/ /rig pas gzugs ni spros nas ni/ /bstod pa nyid dang bsngags par bya/ /de nas gcig ri tu bsams dmigs bya/ /brjod pa'i rim pas rang nyid kyis/ /tshig 'di kha nas smra bar bya/ /sangs rgyas dang ni byang chub sems/ /rdzu 'phrul che ldan srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho 'di la dgongs su gsol/ /zhes pa nyid ni slar brjod nas/ /rmi lam rtag tu nyi ma yi/ /tho rangs la yang rab bsngags 'gyur//mar gyi sbyin sreg sogs sbrang rtsi/ /don med mngon par bzlas byed pa/ /sbyin sreg mngon par mdzes pa ni/ /bgegs gzhom don du brjod par bya/ /so sor dgag pa'i don gyi phyir/ /zhi ba'i sems ni bsngags pa ste/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i don du bya/ /rgyas pa can yang bshad bya ste/ /de bzhin kun tu yang dag bsams/ /sgrub pos legs par bsgrub par bya/ /de nas mdzes pa'i sbyin sreg ni/ /rtag tu 'bad pas bya ba yin/ /nges pa kho nas rdzu 'phrul 'gyur/ /skye ba 'di yi dbang bskur don/ /bil ba mya ngan med la sogs/ /rab brjod pa lā 5sha dang ni/ /a shwat+tha dang pa dzā ku6 /rgyas pa can la sbyin sreg kun/ /de yi yam shing bya ba ni/ /u dum bā 7ra n+ya gro dha/ /a shwat+tha dang 'o mar bcas /gang yang zhi la grags pa nyid/ /las rnams kun la yam shing don/ /sgrub pa 94—139

seng ldeng a riṣ+ṭa/ /nisba dang ni tsher can bshad/ /de bzhin gzhan du mngon mdzes pa/ /yang dag sgrub byed the tsom 1med/ /ba (na bla mig sman la sogs pa/ /rdzas rnams sgrub pa la yang ni/ /ba byung lnga yi gtsang sbra dang / /de tshe rig pa ldan pa yis/ /yang na lha yi chu la ni/ /dri zhim dri sogs yang dag sdom/ /u dum bā dar gsher 'dab bam / /yang na a shwat+tha las byung / /me tog can gyi sngags kyi nang / /bā na tre+e 'am bshol ldan la/ /yongs su srung ba'i cho ga ni/ /byas nas cho ga las bsgrub bya/ /gso sbyong can gyis ji srid du/ /'char ba 'byung ba de srid du/ /nges par sgrub bam mug 'di ni/ /nye bar blang phyir blang bar bya/ /bar skabs 'dir bdag nyid la dgongs su gsol/ zhes pa ni srog chags thams cad gsod pa dang / rtag tu gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa las kyang mi tshangs par spyod pa las dang / lag tu byin pa nyid las kyang rtag tu myos byed 'thung ba dang / skye bo rnams phan tshun gnyis 'thab par byed pa rim pa gang las phreng ba dang / kha dog dang / gar gyi don dang / rol pa dang /dregs pa dang / mal stan chen po dang / mthon po can las log ste gang da lta dgra bcom pa yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i gso sbyong dang ldan par 'gyur ba'o/ /bsdu bar bya'o zhes brjod par bya ba yod par 5bsam pas sems can thams cad kyi don du yang mgron 6du gnyer bar bya'o/ /zhes brjod nas byang chub kyi sems kyis bsdu bar bya'o/ /rtag tu dkon mchog gi rang bzhin gyi skyabs 'gro sngon du 'gro bas yang dag par bskyed nas sgrub 57pa pos rim pa 'dis thams cad mtshams /sbyar nas bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes pa'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a 94—140

'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma sangs rgyas kyis dul ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas 'bras bu 'phel bar 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma 1ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ budhe tā re/ ni dān+ta dharma nir+sā 2te tut+ta re/ a bai brti ka dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma sangs rgyas ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas rab tu mi gnas pa'i bza' ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya 4a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo rnyi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ bud+dha 5 tā 6re/ bud+dha padharme te tu re / bud+dha nadharme nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma sangs rgyas kyi blo gros ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas thabs mkhas pa rnams la blo skye bar byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ su kha de ba tā re/ su kha dharme tut+ta re su kha dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bde ba dang ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu 9bzlas pas nas 'phel ba skye bar byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya / bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ ma na 7tā re dān+ta dharma nir+sā 11te/ tā re tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma 'dul 12ba zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/rtag tu bzlas pas dgra thams cad 'dul bar byed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te1na/ samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya 94—142

re / a dwa ye/ dharme tut+ta re/ a dwa ye ṇ+ḍadharme nir+sā te tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma gnyis su med ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas rgyal po dang blon po gnyis su med par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta (5te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a dwa ye tā re/ mi tri tut+ta re shu raṃ ga me tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma gnyis su med par byams ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas sems can thams cad la byams pa'i bdag nyid can du 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a dwa ye 4dharma nir+sā te/ tā re mi tri/ dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma gnyis su med pa'i dpa' mo zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas spro ba dang ldan zhing dpa' bar 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya / na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ a dwa ye ridharme tu re mi tri dharme tut+ta re/ shu 6ro ga ma ya dharme 7tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma gnyis su med pa'i nachos ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas mi tshugs par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ k+ṣan+ti tā re a dwa ye tā re/ mi tri tut+ta re/ shu raṃ ga me tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzod ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste / rtag tu bzlas pas zhi ba'i sems nyid do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a 94—146

mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ k+ṣan+ti tā re shu 1re ga ma/ dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzod pa'i dpa' mo zhes bya ba ste/rtag tu bzlas pas 2mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā /ya/ ma hā satā ya/ brnye tā re/ mi tri dharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma chos ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas dran par 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ k+ṣan+ti tā re a dwa ye dharma tut+ta re/ a dwa ye mudharma nir+sā te tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzod pa dang gnyis su med ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas rgyal po'i mdun na 6'don du 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satā ya/ brnye tā re a dwa ye pyadharma tā re/ mi tri dharma tut+ta re shu 8re ga ma dharme tu re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzod pa zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas rgyal po'i gnang chen du 'gyur ro/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arta te samyakle bud+dhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ k+ṣan+ti tā re/ a dwa ye (tā re mai tri tut+ta re/ shu 1 raṃ ga me tut+ta re swā hā/ 'di ni 'phags ma sgrol ma bzod pa dang ldan ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa ste/ rtag tu bzlas pas rgyal po'i pho brang du smra 94—147
