bu mos bkal ba'i srad bu la stong phrag brgyad mngon par bsngags pa byas nas bcing bar bya'o/ / skal ba (1)bzang por 'gyur ro/ /dong ma'i me tog stong phrag brgya sbyin sreg gyis shig /gos bye ba bcu gnyis so sor rnyed do/ /rgyal gyi lcags las byung ba'i srang shin tu mdzes pa la 'khor lo 'dab ma bcu pa byas nas ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du ras ris bzhugs nas nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas pas mchod pa rgya chen po byas te 'khor lo blangs nas ji srid du mtshan ma na byung ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /gang gi tshe me stag 'phro chabar byed pa dang / ji srid du la'abar bar 'gyur ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas grub par 'gyur te rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad 'du bar byed cing 'khor dang bcas pa 'phur bar byed do/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po dang bskal pa chen por gnas pa dang / thogs pa med par 'gro bar byed do/ /snga bar langs nas lor bzlas par byed do/ /mchog sbyin par byed do/ /zla ba drug tu lan cig 5ribarjod pas nad chen po grol lo/ /zla ba gcig ridzinatu zlos shig dus ma yin par gu gul gyi bdug pas mche ba'i dug 'bebs par byed do/ /nyin gcig pa dang / nyin gnyis pa dang / nyin gsum pa dang / nyin bzhi pa la sogs pa rnams su'o/ /bud med dbang du byed pa la ras ris kyi spyan sngar lā pan la sbrang rtsi btags pa mtshan mo bdun du thun gsum du sbyin sreg nyi shu rtsa gcig 7 gyis shig dbang du 'gyur ro/ /'di ni yugs sa 6)mos skyes bu yi'o/ /rgyal po ni ras ris kyi spyan sngar arga'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis btags pa stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg gyis shig dbang du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i blon po la sogs pa la mtshan mo thun gsum du lan tshwa 6)nyi shu rtsa gcig ⑩sbyin 94—320

sreg gyis shig dbang du 'gyur ro/ /mgo bo la lan gsum mam bdun du mngon par bsngags nas rgyal po'i sgor 'jug par byed na rgyal po'i gnang 3)chen por 'gyur ro/ /brgyad brgyar mngon par bsngags pa'i rma bya'i mdongs kyis phyag par byas na du dug 'joms so/ /ldong ros a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma'i nang du btums par byas nas stong phrag brgyad du mngon par bsngags pas yang dag par brtsam ( )par bya ste skal ba bzang por 'gyur ro/ /ras ris kyi spyan sngar dkar po'i tshes gcig 4tshonas brtsams te/ 'o ma dang nas zan za zhing dus gsum du khrus byas nas gos lan gsum du 5brjes te/ a ga 6ru dang tu ruṣ+ka tsho7)dang / tsan+dan rnams bsregs shing dkar gsum gyi na cigator ma dbul bar bya'o/ /'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma chu las skyes pa'am/ thang las skyes pa'i dri zhim po'i me tog dang ba'i mar gyi 9mar me gsum mo/ /mthar mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas mtshan thog thag tu bzlas par bya'o/ /gang don du gnyer ba de rnyed do/ /thun mtshams su bza' ba yang ji ltar nus pa sbyin no/ /ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten du ras ris bzhugs nas mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas a shwat+tha'i yam shing la zho dang sbrang rtsi dang / mar gyis btags pa stong phrag brgyad sbyin sreg gyis shig /de nas ras ris las 'od zer 1 'byung ba dang / sa 'gul ba dang / mar me'i rtse mo 'phel ba dang / phreng 11ba g.yo bar byed pa ste/ mtshan ma 'di rnams kyis 12grub par 'gyur ro/ /rna ba'i 1namig sman a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma'i nang du btums te stong phrag rdzogs pa'i sreg 1 blugs byas nas/ skyil mo krung gis nye bar 'dug ste15/ ji srid grub pa rnam tshapa gsum du gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /'bras bu can la gang 'dod 94—321

pa'i rdzas de'i ming bris te stong phrag brgyad du mngon par bsngags pa byas nas gang du klu gnas pa'i mtsho phran der dor bar bya'o/ /de'i klu des las thams cad rdzogs par byed do/ /nyi ma bdun gyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i gos sbyin par byed do/ /'bras bu can la mngon par 'dod pa'i rdzas mngon par bris nas/de bzhin du khron pa'am/ mtsho phran du gzhug 1 par bya'o/ /de nas skyes bu chur byi 'dzul byed du gzhug go/ /der yang sgra chen po skyes bus thos te phyogs che ge mo na rdzas la sogs pa gnas so/ /de na tshan blang bar bya ste chu klung gi mtha' sgrol bar byed pa bgrod dka' ba can gyi 'dun sa'amari ci/ rgyal po'i pho brang du'ang rung ste lha rnams dran par 5byas te gzhan gyis mi thub par 'gyur ro/ /gang du 'dod pa dbang du bya'o/ /de 'phags pa'i zhal du yang bcug nas cung zad yang dag par gsungs skrer mdzod cig ring por mi thogs par dbang du 'gyur ro / /chu snod du byas nas de la 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bsams te stong phrag brgyad du mngon par bsngags pa'i chu des mche ba can la gtor bar bya'o/ /dug med par 'gyur ro/ /de la brjod pa'i cho gas 96swādakyil 'khor du rab tu zhugs pa ni don med par mi 'gyur ro/ /sa la ma lhung ba'i ba byung blangs nas tsā 7ru bza' zhing mi smra bar dkyil 'khor byas nas zla ba nya nas brtsams te ji srid gsum pa'i bar de srid du bzlas par bya ste 'bum bzlas so/ /zla ba drug tu tshangs par spyod pa dang / brtul zhugs 85'di nyid spyad cing zla bas dngos grub dang / zla ba drug gis 'gro ba mtha' dag mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /lus kyis kyang mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed do/ /zla bas sngags thams cad grub par byed do/ /gang 'dod pa'i klu'i 94—322

rgyal po mngon par bris nas de'i steng du rkang pa g.yon pa bzhag ste g.yogs pa'i phyogs su 'bum bzlas par bya'o/ /klu'i rgyal po de 'ong ste de ci bgyi zhes smra bar byed do/ /klu thams cad kyi gnas su rab tu 'jug par gyis shig ces 17brjod par bya'o/ /der rab tu 'jug par byed do/ /de bzhin du gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po bris nas sgrub par byed na bka' bsgo ba byed do/ /thams cad 'dzin pa'i gtsang ma'i gnas nas rdul chung ngu blangs te sbrul gyi steng du yongs su thor cig /sbrul bzlog pa (5)byas par 'gyur ro/ /slar yang gal te grol bar 'dod pa brjod par bya ste gos dkar po'i kha dog can la sa las byung ba'i phyag rgya byas nas stong phrag brgyad mngon par bsngags te mche ba'i steng du 'jog tu bcug nas khug cig shi yang ( kyislong bar byed do/ /ldong ros la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams dang ral gri dang / sta gri dang / 'khor lo dang / bhu nuṇ+ḍa la sogs pa rnams ba byung lngas sbyangs nas stong phrag rdzogs pa'i sreg (blugs bya ste/ rdzas gang yang rung ba blangs nas ras ris kyi spyan sngar cho ga sngon du 'gro bas 'bum phrag lngar zlos shig phyi 55)nas ji ltar byas pa'i rin gyis ldong ros blangs nas byang chub shing gi yam shing gis me sbar te ji srid me'i mdog tu gyur pa de srid du bsreg 6par bya'o / /de nas rgyud mtshungs pa'i ba las byung ba'i 'o ma bu mos bsrubs pas mar du byas nas thal ba mar la gdab par bya'o/ /de bzhin du zhos bkang ba'i snod sbrang rtsis bkang ba la yang ngo / /de nas blangs te gur gum gyi 7za ma tog tu bzhag nas bcom ldan 'das ma 'di nyid kyis bdag nyid srung ba byas te zla ba gzas bzung ba na mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas ras ris la mchod pa rgya chen po byas te a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma gsum gyis kun tu dkris 8nas bzhis 94—323

dgab par bya'o/ /ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste lag pa g.yas pas mnan nas ji srid dro ba dang / du ba 'thul ba dang / 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /dro bzhin pa la thig le byas nas sems can thams cad dbang du byed do/ /du bas mi snang ba'o/ /'bar bas nam mkha' la 'gro'o/ /lo stong phrag bcur 'tsho bar byed do/ /sems can thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /de bzhin du mig sman ba bla sgrub par byed pa dang / gi wang (1)la cho ga 'di'o/ /dkar po'i bcwa na lnga la pad+ma'i 'dab mar bzhag ste ras ris la mchod pa chen po byas nas lag pa kha sbyor gyis blangs te/ ji srid dro ba dang / du ba 'thul ba dang / 'bar bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /'di nyid la dngos grub rnam pa gsum mo/ /ras ris kyi spyan sngar 'bum phrag bcur zlos shig /de nas bzo bo dbang po ma tshang ba min pa gso sbyong can gyis tsho skulcags gsum gyis pad+ma 'dab ma bcu pa'am/ brgyad pa gdan dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa byas nas gur gum cadang / gi wang 5dang / ga bur rnams nam mkha'i chus btags pa pad+mar bcug cing / dkar po'i brgyad pa la / ras ris la mchod pa chen po byas nas mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas pas skyil mo krung gis 'dug ste sdig pa bshags pa dang / gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pa byas nas lag pa g.yas pas pad+ma blangs nas ji srid du 'bar ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas pad+ma des 'khor dang bcas pa dga' bar tsho7)'gyur ro/ /sems can thams cad kyis mi tshugs so/ /lo stong phrag bcur 'tsho bar byed do/ /de bzhin du gdu 8ribu dang / cod pan dang / lcags sgrog dang / rdo rje dang / dgra sta dang /'khor lo yang zhes pa'o/ /'di ni 'khor lo'i khyad par te lcags lnga pa'i 'khor 94—324

lo byas nas so rnon po 'khor lo mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa mtho gang gi tshad do / / gang gā'i hu)'gram gnyis kyis blangs nas ras ris kyi spyan sngar gong bur bya'o / /de la 'khor lo rab tu bzhag nas tsan+dan dmar pos mchod de ka ra bī ra'i me tog dmar po dang phreng ba phul nas dkar po'i brgyad pa la gso sbyong can gyis ()smyung bar gnas pas/ slong ( rimos dge 'dun la ston mo byas te dngos grub stsal bar bya'o/ /gtsang mas 'a)gos gtsang ri5)ma bgos pas snying rje'i sems kyis rab tu sbyar bar bya'o/ /ras ris la mchod pa chen po byas nas dri dang /me tog dang / bdug pa la sogs pa rnams phul nas ji ltar nye bar 'byor ba'i mar me phul nas 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhi ru yang mar me bzhi dang / gu gul gyi bdug pa dbul 6)bar bya'o/ /ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste/ tsan+dan dmar pos btags pa rnams la lan re bzlas te re res bsnun par bya'o/ /ji srid stong phrag brgyad kyi bar du'o/ /de nas 'khor lo sgra dang / 'od zer 97'phro ba dang / de nas 'bar ro gnyis pa la 'khor lo nges par 'gro ste/ de nas sgrub pa pos sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag byas nas rig pa zlos shig de blang bar 48)bya'o/ /blangs pa tsam gyis 'khor dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin par 'gyur te/ dpag tshad stong phrag bcur rig pa 'dzin pa chen po klu dang gnod sbyin gyi rig pa 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mang du 'dod par 'gyur te6) / lo stong phrag lnga 'tsho bar byed do/ /shi na yang bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas ril bu sgrub par 'dod na/ si 7le ta ka dang / tsan+dan dmar po dang / rgya skyegs dang / gu gul dang / tā ra bar ta ma'i rtsa ba dang ske/ lcags kyi phye ma dang / gi ri kuṇ+ḍi dang / 'bru'i phub ma dang / ru rta 94—325

dang / rgya spos dang / sbrang rtsi dang / pi pi ling dang / tu ruṣ+ka 0)rnams gcig nasatu byas nas phye ma zhib mor byed du gzhug go/ /de nas ser skya (5)rgyud mtshungs pa'i ba'i 'o ma blangs nas bu mos bsrubs pa'i mar gyis gcig 54)tu byas nas phye ma des rgya shug 55gi tshig gu tsam gyi ril bu byed du gzhug go/ /de nas dkar po'i brgyad pa'am/ dkar po'i bcu bzhi pa la nyin mtshan du smyung bar gnas pas yan lag brgyad pa'i gso sbyong can gyis ril bu lnga tsam blangs 57te a shwat+tha'i 'dab ma'i nang du btums pa byas nas ras ris kyi spyan sngar bgrang phreng dang til mar dang / phye ma la sogs pa gzhan la sbyin par bya'o/ /ku sha'i khres la nye bar 'dug ste/ mchod pa'i cho ga byas pas lag pa g.yas pas mnan te ji srid du ba 'thul ba de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /yang dag par bgos te/khar bcug pas mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /lha gzugs can rnams 'ong ngo /grub pa rnams thams cad 'thon nas mthong ngo / /lo brgya phrag lngar 77'tsho bar byed do/ /de nas 'bar byed nam mkha' la 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos grub rnam pa gnyis son/ /'di yang bcom ldan 'das ma'i rtsa ba'i rig pa'i las sgrub pa'i thabs su 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa'am bdun pa'i sgrub pa la mtshams med pa lnga byed pa yang 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /rtsa ba'i snying pos kyang las 'di rnams 'grub par byed pa de ji lta ba bzhin du rtogs 9par byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i rtsa ba'i rtog par sgrub thabs thams cad ces bya ba 'di rdzogs so// //de nas yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 7thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams la sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis yang dag par gzigs nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su son pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 94—326

sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la bka' stsal pa/ mi dang 'byung po'i dbus gnas pa'i/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ /dkyil 'khor las can thams cad ni/ /sems dpa' chen po smros shig smros/ /sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor lha rnams dang / /phun tshogs thams cad mngon par 'phel/ /sgrub po rnams la phan pa yi1)/ /don phyir 'dren pas rgyas (5)par smros/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung thams cad kyi/ /lus can bar mar gyur pa rnams/ /khyod kyi tshig gi mchog gyur pa/ /'byung 'gyur de dag thos nas ni/ /myur du lha rnams sgrub pa la/ /sems can gang du rab zhugs pa/ /de nyid du ni sngar bshad pa/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan dang / /sangs rgyas bye ba stong rnams kyis/ /thams cad de la rjes yi rang / /dkyil 'khor sdig pa kun 'joms pa/ /dngos grub kun byed dge ba ni/ /sems can rnams kyi mgon pos smros/ /sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor khyod kyi tshig /sems can cho ga yang dag 'gyur/ /dkyil 'khor gang 'di thos nas ni/ /rab tu dad pa skye bar 'gyuratsho / /dpal min 'joms shing zhi ba dang / /de bzhin nad dang dgra 'phrog cing / /dkyil 'khor sems can thams cad kyi/ /gzi brjid stobs ni rnam par 'phel /mthong ngam thos (4)nas de nas ni/ /rab tu dad pa skyed par byed/ /gang yin de rnams bdag gis ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub ni/ /thob pa'i ched du'ang lung bstan to/ /ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'byung 'gyur ba/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyang ni/ /rjes su yi rang 'gyur ba yin/ /dkyil 'khor phun tshogs 'phel byed pa/ /de bzhin yon tan kun sdud pa/ /sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor rmad byung ba/ /sems dpa' chen po 'jig rten mgon/ /yang dag 94—327

bka' yis smros shig smros/ /de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig (41)tu byas nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der thal mos phyag 'tshal dzon nas/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la tha mi dad pa'i tshigs su bcad pas ( )bstod pa'i tshig gis mngon par bstod do/ /shākya'i rgyal po lha yi rgyal/ /phun tshogs yon tan du ma can/ /rab bsngags rdzu 'phrul rab ma nyams/ /rgyun du dkar ba'i gos dang ldan/ /mchod sdong zhal ni 'dam skyes dri/ /blo bzang snying po bstan 4pa 'dzin/ /gang phyir khyod ni phun tshogs nyid(ge/ /'di ni 'gro ba de dag gi/ /dga' bas dga' bar byed pa ni/ /mgon po lha rnams kyi ni ste/ /rang bzhin dran pas kun tu snang / /de yi tshig ni rab rig pa/ /dpa' de chags pa zad pa nyid/ /'bras bu gsum nyid 'dzin par byed/ /de de gzhan ⑥du de yis ni/ /lha yi mdzes mas kun bsrungs pa/ /brgyad kyis 'dir zhinani dbang zhal las/ /skyes pa'i dpa' bo (8)rab stobs dang / /g.yo ba'i spro dga'i dbang po dang / /kun nas gser gyi ri dang ldan/ /cod pan yang ni lhan cig gdan / /lha dang lha min lhar bcas pa'i/ /lhag pa'i theg pa thams cad kyang 9ri/ /'jig rten bar do'i srid pa dang / /skye ba khyod kyi srog la sogs/ /byung ba mdzes ldan rang nyid kyi/ /'di yi mig ni dga' ba ste/ /gang rnams zla ba lta bur dkar/ /lha rnams kyis bzung ri bong can/ /kun da du ku dkar po yi / /gos ni mnabs 7nyid tsa ko ra/ /brgya byin 'dab brgya pa yi mig /sa sungs 11phrag par phyogs gcig 'gro/ /bla ma'i ri la ri bong can/ /rgyal po'i 94—328

dpung ldan brgya byin ni/ /mig brgya brtson 'grus ma nyams pas/ /grangs dang chu gter chu 'byin pa/ /tshogs kyi sgra ni dga' ba dang / /dri med spyan ni dga' ba 6)la'ang / /nyi ma'i 'od zer dam pa ni/ /rnam pas (gezas dang dri 'khor ba/ /bum dkar gang ba so so yi/ /bum pa de rnams dbang bskur zhing ske/ /tsan+dan sa mchog yan lag bshad/ /gi bang 9 nithig le rnam par bkra /yan lag dam pa yongs 'du ba'i/ /dga' ba mchog gi yan lag dang / /lus med gzhom pa'i ched du byas/ /yan lag chags pa byas mtha' las/ /khrus ni stug pos mi 'pho bas/ /gzhan du 'chi med legs pa ni/ /de 'og thal mo sbyar ba yi/ /dug gis btab pa smad pa ltar/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchog brjod pa'i/ /char ldan khyod kyi zhal du ni/ /sngon las khyod ni lam gyi mgo/ /dri ma bzhin du spangs pa yang / /me tog ldan pa'i zla ba la/ /rnam par tshar tsholaphyin longs spyod ldan/ /bcings pa lta bur 'di rnams nyid/ /btsos 5nas sngar med cho ga yis/ /bcu par khyod ni zhi ba ste/ /mabon 6med 'gro ba mtha' yas las/ /gang phyir srid pa mtha' med 7cing / /dri mas lha dang lha min yang / /de yi brtul zhugs phan tshun du/ /dam pa'i spyan gyi 'od kyis 8snang / /'khyil ba spyan 59)yangs yan lag samachog /phyogs su lha rnams gnas pa dang / /mi rnams byang chub rnam sangs rgyas/ /rab tu byed 'gyur zhes pa ni/ /mi rnams 'byung dang sdud pa'i las/ /de phyir rnam 11pad chu skyes ni/ /lha yi yan lag dam par 3geson/ /dpa' bo'i yan lag dkris chags bral/ /'chi bzhin sa yi lus kyang 'khod/ /kun nas gtod dang kun nas sdud/ /yang dag sa dang phyogs dang ldan/ /rnam bzhi mnyam par byang chub ldan/ /byang chub shing 94—329

drung bdud dpung las/ /rnam par rgyal ba thob pa dang / /sangs rgyas go 'phang 'pho med dang / /klu yi shing gi rtsa ba ru/ /zhe sdang rtsub po'i nags rnams kyis/ /rkang pa stong 1 bu me rinasayi ched/ /rmongs mun dri ma snang byed pa/ /khro bo'i me ni 'bar ba la/ /mi g.yo rab tu sbyin par byed/ /phyag rgya rdo rje lta bu sgom / /gzhal dba'i 'khri shing gzugs brnyan brtan54 / /dmar po'i me ni 'bar ba ni/ /'jigs pa'i nyi ltar rnam mdzes pa/ /yan lag stobs bskyed phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams kyis mngon par bstod nas rang gi stan la 'khod de/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya ba la snyoms par zhugs so/ /snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu sems dpa' chen po'i zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer bye (de ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma byung ste 'od zer de rnams kyis gang gā'i bye ma dang mnyam pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kun tu snang bar byas par gyur to/ /dmyal ba pa'i sems can thams cad kyang skad cig de dang yud tsam de la sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral bar gyur to/ /gang sangs rgyas kyi zhing de rnams su sangs rgyas 6bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyis byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ legs so legs so/ /sems dpa' chen po 7smras shig /mthu chen po sems can sdig pa can thams cad dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba smros shig /gang gis de lta bu de rnams phyogs bcu mtha' yas pa mu med pa rnams su sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' dang / nyan thos kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba dang /94—330

lhan cig byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba gnang ba dang / sa chen po ri dang / nags dang / phug tu bcas pa 'di rab tu g.yos so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sngags bshad par brtsams so/ /dang por re zhig 1bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi slob dpon dam tshig mthong bas naslob dpon dang mtshungs pa'i rjes su gnang ba thob cing dad pas byang chub tu sems bskyed pa/ sems can rnams kyi stobs dang /stobs ma yin pa shes pa/ ser sna med cing g.yo sgyu med pas nag po med cing ha cang mi sbom/ ha cang mi phra ba dri ngan pa med pas dbang po ma tshang ba ma yin pa/mdzes pa/ snying stobs dang ldan pas sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang /bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab dang /snying rje dang yang dag par ldan par gyur pa/ sems can gyi dgongs pa dang /bsam pa shes pa dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la mngon par dang ba/ cha mang po mngon par shes pa/ gsal zhing gsal bar smra ba/dkyil 'khor bri ba'i las la byang ba/ rig gsum gang yang rung ba'i rig pa la sogs pas sngon du bsnyen pa byas pa / phyag dang dkyil 'khor gyi rab tu sbyor ba shes pa/ mchod rten gyi las byas pa/ ha cang mi rgan byis pa dang /rigs dma' bar skyes pa ma yin pa/ gzhon zhing lang tsho dang ldan pa dang /tshul bzang po'i sgrub pa pos gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o zhes so/ /de nas 'di lta bu'i slob dpon gyis 5bcom ldan 'das ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga 94—331

brtsam par bya ste/ nus med 'dul nyes ma yin pa/ /dkyil 'khor yang dag rab sbyar bya/ /rmongs pa'i sems dang chags can la/ /dkyil 'khor bstan par yang mi bya/ /gang zhig bslab la yud tsam yang / /lhag par 'gro ba'i lus can des/ /mtho ris thar pa yang dag 'grub/ /yid kyi dbang phyug thob par 'gyur / /byang chub sems ni rjes zhig pa'i/ /dngos grub dmigs pa nyid mi 'gyur / /byang chub rtsa bar rig thob pa'i/ /sems tsho1)de las ni yang dag brtsaman) / /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rab tu dang ba'i sems can rnams/ /bdag nyid kho nar rab rtogs bya/ /de la bstan bya'i na)dkyil 'khor bri/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis/ /stobs kyis sngon 'dul si tha'i lus/ /cho 'phrul gyi ni zla phyed la//grong dang grong khyer grong cardal dang / /ljongs rnams su ni byang shar gyi/ /phyogs kyi cha ru mchod yon byin(5/ /sa yi mthil du de ji ltar/ /sa phyogs sngags la sngags 'gyur ba/ /snum dang 5ljon shing me tog bzang / /'bras bu (spyi yang dag mang po can/ /rgyun mi 'chad par 58tsho'abab pa'i phyogs/ /dkar dang ser ba'i sa gzhi la/ /gyo mo bong ba gseg ma bral/ /rnga bo che yi sgra dbyangs dang / /lam gyi bzhi mdo 9dur khrod dang / /lha gzhan yongs su bzung ba dang / /shis 1 shing 11sdug bsngal rdzogs spangs la/ /gang du kun nas rgyang grags lnga'i/ /tshad du chu klung lteng 12ka dang / /mtsho phran chu bo rab 'bab pa/ /ljon shing mchod rten lha khang dang / /me tog nyid ni dus rgyun du/ /shin tu rgya chen yang dag ldan/ /cho 'phrul phyogs ni gang rung la/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor slob dpon sa phyogs der/ /nyi ma gung la song 94—332

nas ni/ /ral pa gcig ma'i snying po yi/ /mngon par mdzes pa'i las bya'o/ /thog mar rab dag sems can kun/ /byams dang snying rje dang ldan pas/ /dkyil 'khor gnas der yid kyis dmigs/ /dge ba'i rig pa gdon par bya/ /sgrol ma'i snying po dam pa dang / /de bzhin dbyangs ni rjes su gdon/ /'dir ni sangs rgyas mchod don du/ /dkyil 'khor lus can kun gyis bri/ /phyogs kyis 'gro ba'i gnas su gnas/ /thog mar gtor ma byin byas nas/ /dri yi yam shing yang dag ldan/ /gnas su gnas pas kun zos nas/ /go rims (1 bzhin du spyan drang ba'i(na)/ /dbyangs kyis ri )tshig 'di brjod par bya/ /slob dpon ming ni che ge bdag /bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni bri bar 'tshal/ /bdag dang sems can kun gyis gang / /bdag mthar gdug (4)pa'i sems med pa/ /bskyed cing bkur stir byed pa dang / /sangs rgyas bstan la rab dad pa'i5/ /sems can rnams la phyir zhing ni/ /mang du rab tu dad pa'i ched/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar bdag 'tshal lo/ /de ltar lan gnyis lan gsum brjod/ /de nas sems can de rnams ni/ /dkyil 'khor gyi ni slob dpon gyis / /mtshan mo mthong ba sbyin par byed/ /de nas bris pa'am gzhan du song / /tho rangs rmi lam rnam par spyad/ /sa yi phyogs der song nas ni/ /khru brgya yi ni tshad du yang / /kun nas gru bzhi pa ru bya/ /phyi rol dpag tu med pa yi/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi tshad song nas/ /sa 7la shing dang phub ma dang / /thal ba sol ba so phag dang / /skra dang sen mo mchod sbyin gyi(8)/ /so phag nag po la sogs gang / /gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dge ba yi / /mi dge'i zug rngu thams cad kun/ /lhag ma med par bsal nas ni/ /94—333

sa yi gong bu de nyid du/ /gzhan yang chu klung chen po yi/ /'gram gnyis sa ni sbyang byas nas/ /rab tu bcug ste tho bas brdung / /tsan+dan chu yis yang dag gtor / /de ltar byas nas ma ltung ba'i/ /ba byung tsan+dan chu bsres nas/ /khru brgyad pa yi phyogs su ni/ /phyi rol gyis kyang khru bcu yi(1ni/ /tshad (2du yongs su sbyangs pa la/ /gso sbyong sbyin nonas byug tu gzhug /ji srid sa yi phyogs der ni / /shin tu 'jam zhing shin tu ni/ /legs par rdzogs par skyes (0kyi bar/ /de ltar nyi ma bdun du ni/ /de nas khru bzhi'i tshad du ni/ /grwa bzhi seng ldeng phur bu brgyad/ /sor mo bcu gnyis tshad du bya/ /gzhon nu mas bkal srad bu ni / /tshon sna lnga pa legs 'jam pa/ /shin tu sra ba bcom ldan ma'i/ /rtsa ba'i snying po lan bdun gyis/ /bsngags 5pas phur bu la dkris nas/ /bdun byas srod la gdab par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis/ /gtsang ma'i gos ni bgos pa yis/ /dkyil 'khor sa yi dbus de ru/ /rtsa ba nag po med pa yi/ /bum blang dri yi chu dang ni/ /me tog sgron 6rims bkang ba la/ /mgrin par me tog phreng bar dkris / /a mra'i yal 'dab 8kha dgab bya/ /pus mo dag ni nges btsugs nas/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa bdun byas te/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa gcig 9ribarjod/ /de nas phyogs bcur kun bltas nas/ /'di ni bsgrag 7bya che ge dag /gnas 'dir sangs rgyas mchod pa'i phyir/ /sems can kun gyi ting 'dzin ni/ /bsam byas dkyil 'khor bris pa 'dir/ /sangs rgyas phan par mdzad pa kun/ /dkyil 'khor du ni byon par mdzod/ /da lta 'dir ni byon nas kyang / /bdag gi mchod yon bzhes su gsol/ /de dbus nyid du brtag bya ba/ /gnas su bris pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /spyan drang bya zhing lha 94—334

rnams kyi/ /gnas mdor bstan nas 1)brjod par bya/ /dga' ldan du ni byang chub sems/ /'jig rten gzhan du gang gnas pa/ /de bzhin kha ba'i gnas su dang / /gang ldan pad+ma'i dbang phyug 'byung / /lcang lo can du nor dbang phyug /te sdonase ru ni bde byed bshad/ /mchod yon snod ni bkang ba yis de rnams gnas ni rnam bsam bya/ /de nas zhal ni srub bsnyen 4)bkur/ /dkyil 'khor las rnams thams cad la/ /ming dang gnas ni yongs nyams na/ /phyin ci log tu ldog par 'gyur/ /de ltar nyi ma bdun du ni/ /nyin re nyin re tsan+dan gyi/ /chu yis byug tu gzhug par bya/ /mtshan mo'i thun la'ang de bzhin bya / /bar 95'dir yo byad thams cad ni/ /rnam par 'byor par 'gyur ba yin / /de la 'di ni brjod bya ste/ /dag pa'i shel dang mtshungs pa yi/ /phye ma rdo rje'i rang bzhin skyes/ /dzi ba'i me tog dang mtshungs pa'i/ /phye mas dkyil 'khor kun tu bri/ /pad+ma rā ga ut+pa la/ /phye ma mtha' dag gis gdab bya/ /gur gum chu dang mtshungs pa dang / /put+pa rā ga yi dkyil 'khor/ /zar ma'i me tog dang mtshungs shing / /de bzhin ma ra ka tas kyang / /de tsam kha dog rin chen ma/ /lcags kyang rung ste ming can lnga/ /yang na dris btags ( phye mas sam / /ji ltar snyed 75pa rnam na sprul pas/ /rab bkug rin chen phye ma yis/ /yang dag pa yi 99dngos grub 'dod/ /nor bu mching 1 bu mtshungs min gang / /pad+ma rā gas rnam pa kun/ /dkyil 'khor yo byad thams cad kyang / /slob dpon gyis ni gzhon nu ma'i/ /lag pas byed du gzhug par bya/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rigs skyes pa/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang / /ma nor skyes pa rab mdzes pa/ /dbang po ma tshang ma yin pa/ /mdor na bud med mtshan nyid 94—335

dang / /yang dag ldan par skyes pa yis/ /'di 'dra'i gzhon nu ma gcig 6)gnyis / /gsum la gso sbyong sbyin nas ni/ /'o ma'i zas kyis mngon dga' bar / /byas nas dkar po'i gos (gebagos te/ /dkyil 'khor yo byad thams cad ni/ /byed gzhug (shedakyil 'khor yo byad kun/ /legs bsags so sor brtags pa yis/ /chu dang rnam par dben ④pa dang / /dge slong 'dul ba byas pa dang / /yongs su sbyang ba byas pa dang / /gtsang sbra'i spyod pa sngon 'gro bas / /slob dpon rang gi lhag gnas ched/ /phye (5)ma thams cad bdug pa bri4)//gtor ma dang ni mar rnams ni/ /cho ga can gyis byed du gzhug /de nas slob dpon yo byad kun/ /tshogs nas dkyil 'khor rang nyid bri/ /slob ma yongs su bzung 7ribar gyis/ /de rnams sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /dge slong dge 'dun la rab dang 8/ /yan lag cha shas kun rdzogs pa/ /bden par smra dang sbom pa min/ /mdzes pa mthong dang kha dog gtsigs/ /gzung bar mi bya gcig gnyis gsum/ /bcwa 49ribargyad dang ni gzhan bcu drug /de rnams skyabs gsum yongs su 'dzin/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed pa dang bo/ /'o ma'i ston mo bza' ba dang / /'o ma'i shing las byung ba yi/ /so shing sor mo brgyad kyi tshad / /bcom ldan rtsa ba'i snying po yis/ /lan ni nyi shu rtsa bdun du/ /mngon par bsngags nas ba yi gcin/ /rab sbyar mtshan mo'i thun mtshams su/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi phyi rol du/ /shar du mngon phyogs ku sha yi47/ /khres la rim pas nyer 12'dug nas/ /snying po re re lag par byin/ /rtsa ba'i snying po lan bdun bzlas/ /gtsug tor bcing la'ang bdun bzlas bya/ /de nas so shing de rnams la/ /byin nas rang rang so shing bza'/ /ral gcig ma yi snying 94—336

po yis/ /lan bdun bsngags pa'i dri yi chus/ /spyi bor mngon par gtor (17bar bya/ /de nas de rnams la brjod bya/ /bcom ldan 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs / /dbang phyug mchog gi thugs rje can/ /chen po'i mchog ni sbyin pa po / /bsgral dka' sgrol ba dran par gyis/ /bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma yang //rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /skyed kyipar byed ma dran par gyis/ /de yi 'og tu slob dpon gyis/ /slob ma de rnams kun la ni/ /'dod chags bral dang ldan pa'i chos/ /brtan par byas nas de rnams mdun/ /shes rab pha rol phyin bklag bya/ /de lta bu yi cho ga yis/ /bud med rnams kyang yongs gzung (5)bya/ /langs nas bu mos bkal ba yis / /srad bu tshon sna lnga pa ni/ /mi mnyam rgyud du bsgrim pa la/ /dri yi chu yis mngon bkrus nas/ /re rer 95)pad+ma'i bgrang phreng gis/ /bsang (tshigator byas nas rtsa ba yi/ /snying po lan grangs nyer gcig (75tu/ /mngon bsngags de la 'dir brjod bya/ /dpal gyi gzhi ni yod pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi zhabs mtshan ma/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'byung ba ste/ /pad+ma'i bgrang phreng de phyir bsngags / /de nas slob dpon rang nyid kyis/ /slob ma rnams la cha phra mos /lag pa la ni bcing bar bya/ /slob ma rnams la gang kho na/ /de nyid slob ma bdag nyid bya/ /de nas dkyil 78'khor lhag gnas pa/ /shar du mngon phyogs bla gos ni/ /phrag pa gcig tu byas nas ni/ /pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga ni/ /sa la rab tu btsugs byas te/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya bcing ba dang / /rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas par bya/ /sangs rgyas byang chub thams cad dang / /rang rgyal 'phags pa nyan thos dang / /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /lha mi'i 99dri dang 94—337

me tog gi/ /phreng ba yongs su 'dzin pa yis/ /kun la gsol ba gdab par bya / /dkyil 'khor gyi ni slob dpon bdag /che ge mo zhes bya ba yis/ /bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol ma yi/ /dkyil 'khor bri bar 'tshal lags na/ /de dag rang nyid byon par mdzod/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kun dang / /byang chub sems dpa' rang sangs rgyas/ /nyan thos lha klu gnod sbyin dang / /dri za lha min nam mkha' lding / /mi 'am ci dang lto 'phye che/ /rang gi rig pa sngags tshogs kyis/ /yongs bskor sems can thams cad la/ /rjes su brtse bas byon nas kyang / /bdag la rjes su gnang bar mdzod/ /de ltar yang gnyis yang gsum du/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa bzlas pa dang / /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la bltas nas/ /dbus su me gyo)tog phreng ba dor/ /gal te me tog phreng g.yo byed/ /de nas byon par shes par bya /de nas sangs rgyas byang sems la/ /dri yi chu yis mchod yon dang / /me tog phul cig de nas ni/ /khru brgya'i phyi rol sa gzhi la/ /yongs su sbyang ba byas pa ru / /a pā marga'i 2yam shing gis/ /me ni rab tu sbar byas nas/ /shar du mngon phyogs ku sha yis/ /rtsa ba'i snying po sbrang rtsi zho/ /mar gyi sreg rdzu —)blugs brgyad brgyar dbul/ /de nas sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /lha rnams la yang 4mchod yon dbul/ /de nas dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi ru/ /gso sbyong yongs su blangs pa yis/ /skyes bu srung ba'i phreng ba dang / /dbang po tshang ba gzhag 5par bya/ /de la 'dir ni brjod bya ste/ /gang zhig rnam pa gzhan bya ba//skyong ba bral bar 'gyur ba ste/ /dkyil 'khor dam tshig brgyad rnams ni/ /yang dag 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir cho ga byas pa yis/ /slob mas dam 94—338

tshig shes par 'gyur/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon gang / /rab gnas slob mas thabs cig tu/ /song nas ku sha bting ba la1/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs kun rjes su dran pa yis2/ /g.yas pa'i gzhogs kyis nyal bar bya/ /de nas tho rangs slob dpon gyis/ /gtsang ma shar du kha phyogs pas/ /rmi lam rnam par dpyad par bya/ /de la 'di ni brjod bya ste/ /gang zhig tsan+dan bil ba sogs/ /u dum bār sogs n+ya gro dha/ /rgyal mtshan phreng bas khyab pa dang / /rmi lam rab tu dad pa'ang rung / /kha cig me lce mdzes pa dang / /de ltar mthong ba de dngos grub/ /mchog gi bar du'o ngang pa dang / /kā raṇ+ḍa ri ba krung krung dang / /rma bya ro ha ṇa rnams ni/ /gang zhig de lta (5)bu mthong 'gyur/ /rmi lam bar ma'i dngos grub de/ /myur ba kho nar 'byung bar 'gyur/ /ma 'am ra ha ṇa yang rung / /de bzhin pi wang thogs pa dang / /kuṇ+ḍa la sogs pa yang rung / /de bzhin a sogs 'adhi mthong na / /gang yang rmi lam mthong byed pa/ /mi rnams tha ma'i dngos grub de/ /sgrol ma'i rtog par nges par bstan/ /gtum po khyi yi lag pa rnams/ /gang gis mthong bar gyur pa dang / /bong bu rnga mo shing rta sogs/ /mthong dang reg pa nyid sogs sam/ /rgya skyegs til mar gyis reg pa/ /gang gis rmi lam du 'jug pa/ /de yi dngos grub nges par gnas/ /dam tshig tsam du 'byung bar 'gyur / /de lta bu sogs yon tan ldan/ /rmi lam blo yis rnam dpyad nas/ /de ltar rab blo gang shes nas/ /slob ma de la rmi lam gyi/ /lung du yang ni bstan par bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon ni/ /gal te khyim gnas gyur pa'am/ /dge slong dge slong ma dang ni/ /dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma yang 94—339

rung / /chen po de rnams gso sbyong ni/ /bzung ste phyi 6)nas slob ma rnams/ /gso sbyong yang dag gus par bya/ /slob ma rmi lam mi dge ba/ /bstan bya sngon du sbyin sreg bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon ni/ /snga ma kho nar sa dang ni / /ras ris mthar ni a lā sa )/ /zangs las 'byung ba rab zhugs te/ /yang dag 'jog par byed du gzhug /de nas dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la/ /tsan+dan chu yis legs par byug(4 /slob ma thams cad gnas cig (5nyetu/ /snying pos (6)bsrung 7rib byas nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor phyi yi gnas gcig (85tu/ /nyer 'dug dam tshig shes pa rnams/ /nang du rab tu gzhug par bya/ /de nas nyi ma nub dus su/ /dkyil 'khor thig ni gdab par bya/ /bu mos bkal 5)ba'i srad bu ni / /tshon sna lnga pa rtsa ba yi/ /snying po lan bdun bsngags byas te/ /dbang ldan phyogs nas brtsams nas ni/ /phur bu de rnams srad bus bcings de dag thams cad khru yi tshad/ /gsum byas slad bus yongs dkri bya/ /phyi nas kun tu dung dang ni/ /rnga bo che dang rdza rnga dang / /'khar mngo rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i / /'khar 511ba dang ni pheg /rterdob rnams/ /kun nas 'khrol bar byed du gzhug /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs/ /phyi rol du ni dgram par bya / /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ /tshon sna lnga pa'i thig skud kyis/ /khru brgyar byas nas thig gdab bya/ /de lam dkyil 'khor gnyis pa ste/ /de nas kha dog thams cad pa/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya bcings /snyenas ni/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa brgyad brgyar ngabazlas/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /rang sangs rgyas dang tshe'aphags pa yi/ /nyan thos dge 'dun rnams la ni/ /phyag byas dkyil 'khor khor yug tu/ /rgyang 94wa 340

grags 6)lnga pa lhag gnas che/ /ral pa gcig pa'i snying po yis/ /gdug pa'i sems can thams cad kyi/ /sems ni bcing bar bya ba'o/ /dkyil 'khor yang ni thams cad kyi/ /slob dpon gyi ni yo byad rnams/ /ral gcig nasnying po nyid kyis ni/ /thog mar bsrung ( ba byas nas ni/ /byang shar phyogs nas brtsams byas te/ /tshangs pa'i thig ni gdab par bya/ /rtsa ba'i rig pa zlos pa nyid / /dkyil 'khor thams cad mkhas pas bris/ /yongs su bcad cing lus dkar ba'i/ /slob de de bzhin gshegs rnams la/ /phyag bya 94 rin chen phye mas so / /pad+ma'i rigs la phyag byas te/ /phye ma ser pos bcom ldan ma/ /'phags ma sgrol ma phyag byas nas/ /ljang gu 95)rnams kyis nyan thos kun/ /rang sangs rgyas kun phyag byas nas/ /nag pos rdo rje'i rigs la'o/ /de ltar dang pos dkyil 'khor gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa'i snying por ro/ /phyi nas gnyis la khru gnyis kyi tshad du rab tu 'jug par byed pa'o/ /gsum pa mtho gang pa de'i nyis 'gyur ro / /de ltar thams cad du rim gyis bris nas nang gi dkyil 'khor du bri bar 'dod pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad der rang byon par mdzad du gsol/ 'bru thams cad dang rin po che thams cad dang sman thams cad dang / dri dang me tog thams cad dang / tsan+dan gyi chus yongs su bkang ba/ mā ṣa'i 6yal 'dab 7kyis kha bkab (8)pa/ du ku la'i ras dkar pos mgrin pa bcings pa/ gser dang dngul las byung ba/ dkyil 'khor de'i yo byad thams cad ras ris gnyis pa'i mthar me tog gi phreng bas dkris nas rtsa ba'i rig pas bsngags pa de rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa zhes bya ba ste/ snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gzhag 994—341

par bya'o/ /de la 'di brjod par bya ste/ dam tshig don dang bsod nams (1 don / /'dod don so sor dmigs byed du/ /sdom pa gzung bar byas tsun)gyur nas / /gang du gnas pa thams cad nas/ /dkyil 'khor mchog 'di bri bar bya / /gzhan gyis mi thub thugs rje che/ /sangs rgyas byams pa spyan mar bcas/ /'di rnams ming ni kun drangs rinanas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bri bar bya/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal dkar mor grags/ /de bzhin du ni khro gnyer can/ /khros ma zhes ni grags pa ste/ /'di rnams ming ni kun dran nas/ /spyan ras gzigs ni bri bar bya/ /rig pa mchog las slar 'jigs byed/ /rdo rje ser skya rdo rje ni/ /drag por bzhed dang seng ge dang / /de bzhin rdo rje khu tshur nyid/ /'di rnams ming ni kun nas ni/ /phyag na rdo rje kun tu bri/ /de nas dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyis/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phye ma dkar po dang / yungs kur dkar po bsres pas 4)sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rin po che'i seng ge'i gdan la nye bar bzhugs pa chos ston par mdzad bzhin pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor 'od kun tu 'phro ba/ gtsug tor nas 'od zer 'byung bzhin pa'i bcom ldan 'das rnam pa mchog thams cad dang ldan pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa dang por bris shing 55/ bcom ldan 'das kyi steng gi gzhogs gnyis su phye ma ser po dang / pad+ma ge sar phan tshun bsres pas gtsug tor gyi rgyal po rnams kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa 'khor los sgyur neba'i rgyal po chen po'i gzugs dang / cha byad dang / dbyibs kyi rnam pa can rab tu dang ba'i sku de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par phyogs pa/ sa bon gyis gang ba dang / 'bras bu 7phyag na bsnams pa la 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 94—342

'das rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / 'khor los sgyur 1ba dang / kun nas 'bar ba'i gtsug tor dang / gdugs dkar po dang / gzi brjid phung po dang / nor bu'i phung po dang / gser gyi phung po dang / rnam par grags pa'i phung po dang / kun nas phung po dang / nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i phung po dang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi phung po dang / rtag pa'i phung po dang / dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin gyi 2phung po dang / thams cad phung po dang / sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i phung po dang / 'jig rten gsum pa'i phung po dang / mtha' yas phung po dang / bsod nams phung po dang /lha'i phung po zhes pa 'di rnams g.yas kyi gzhogs su nye bar bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / mngon par 'phags pa dang / rnam par rgyal ba'i gtsug tor dang / mngon par mtho ba dang / sa'i 'dab ma dang / 'dab ma brgya pa dang / 'dab ma stong pa dang / 'od zer 4)dang / 'od zer 5chen po dang / dri ma med pa'i 'od zer nedang / bkod pa'i 'od zer 7dang / dkar po'i 'od zer nadang / pad+ma'i 'od zer (9nodang / bkod pa'i gtsug tor dang / bdud bzhi'i 1 rnam par 'dul ba'i gtsug tor dang / gtsug tor mngon par 'phags pa dang /bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gtsug tor zhes pa 'di rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i nus pa dang / lung bstan pa zhes gtsug tor gyi rgyal po 'di rnams g.yon gyi steng du bri bar bya'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur 11ba'i nye logs su phreng 12gcig la brten pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo brgyad bri ste/ bcom ldan 'das ma spyan ma dang / mdzod spu dang / zla ba dang / snying rje ma dang / byams pa 94—343

ma dang / mi 'jigs ma dang / lung bstan ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i nus pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i 6)'khrugs pa rab tu dang ba'i sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i dri ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyi dra ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu snang ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i nye ba'i snying po zhes pa 'di rnams pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/rab tu dang ba'i sku cung zad de bzhin gshegs pa la nges par rtog bzhin pa/rang gi gzugs las rab tu snang ba'i sku bri'o/ /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur (guba'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa chen po khro bo'i gzugs can pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ kun nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor can/rtse gsum dang zhags pas phyag brel bsgyu ni/ cung zad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan la blta ba'o / /gzhan du rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi nye logs su phreng gcig la brten 5 pa'i rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo brgyad la 'di lta ste/bcom ldan 'das ma gzhan gyis 6mi thub ma dang / phyi nas dge sbyong ma dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzes ma dang / sangs rgyas dkar mo dang / de bzhin gshegs ma sems ma dang / de bzhin gshegs pa lcags kyus 'gugs ma zhes pa 'di rnams pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sku'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon par phyogs pa'o/ /'di rnams kyi steng du gsang sngags kyi rgyal po brgyad la 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtha' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i kun tu snang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mkhyen pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'jig rten gsum dang / de 94—344

bzhin gshegs pa'i 'dus pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'jig rten zhes pa 'di rnams kun nas 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis yongs su bskor ba/ pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ rab tu dang ba'i sku de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan la lta bar gyur pa'o/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug tor gyi 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i yan lag dang ldan pa (17zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal po kun nas 'od pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ phyag na pad+ma ste/ de rnams thams cad lha'i gzugs g.yas pas sa bon gyis 9migang ba dang / phyag g.yon pas mchog sbyin pa/ rang gi cha byad kyis kun tu gnas par yang ngo / /gtsug tor gyi rgyal po'i steng du rang sangs rgyas brgyad ji ltar rig par bri bar bya'o/ /'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das snyan grags zhes bya ba'i rang sangs rgyas dang steng gi drang srong dang / drang srong chen po dang / lha'i drang srong dang / mā da ra dang / brtsegs pa dang /legs par brtsegs pa dang / brtsegs pa chen po zhes pa rang dasangs rgyas brgyad po 'di rnams pad+ma'i gdan la skyil mo krung gis nye bar 'dug pa/ ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ bla gos ser po can no/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 'og tu yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i phyag rgya'o//g.yon du snam sbyar ro/ /mdun gyi 'og tu chos kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad pa la gnas pa'o / /de'i yang nye logs su khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa zhes bya ba ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa dang / bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bka' nod par byed bzhin pa'i 'og tu pad+ma rigs 94—345

mdzes ma zhes bya ba'i rig pa'i rgyal mo bri bar bya'o/ /pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar 'dug pa/ ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ dar la dang / ras kyi smad g.yogs dang stod g.yogs 1can/ thal mo sbyar ba byas pa cung zad sgrol ma'i gzugs la lta bar gyur pa/ bka' nod par byed bzhin pa'o/ /de'i gong du pad+ma chen po zhes bya ba'i khro bo namadog dmar po kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar 'dug pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bka' nod ripar byed bzhin pa'o/ /khro bo'i rgyal po de rnams thams cad kun nas 'bar ba chen po'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor dang rnam par 'gyur ba'i gzugs 'chang ba/ dar dang ras kyi smad g.yogs can/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa'i lus su bya'o/ /sgrol ma'i g.yon gyi gzhogs su byang chub sems dpa' mthu chen thob sku mdog dkar po ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ dar la'i stod g.yogs can / dar la dang ras kyi smad g.yogs can / pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal bzhin pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi pad+ma'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa' dri ma med par 55'gro ba zhes bya ba pri 6yang ku ltar sngo bsangs cung zad 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang / pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar 'dug pa/ ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ g.yo ba dang bcas pa'i smad g.yogs dang / dar la'i stod g.yogs 'chang ba/ shin tu dang ba'i sku / 'od zer 7'bar ba/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal bzhin pa'o/ /dri ma med pa na 'gro ba'i steng gi g.yon du bcom ldan 'das spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dbyug pa dang / ril ba spyi blugs dang / bgrang phreng 94—346

dang / g.yang gzhi nag po can dang / rab tu dang 1ba'i sku 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'dod pa phun tshogs byed pa pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa sku dkar po pad+ma'i sdong bus dkris pa'i lus can/ phyag g.yon pas pad+ma dang / g.yas pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu phyag tu bkod pa/ 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ cung zad 'dzum pa'i bzhin ras can/ phyag na rdo rje'i g.yas kyi (2)snam bu gcig ( skul rig pa'i rgyal po chen po bri bar bya'o/ /'di lta ste/bcom ldan 'das rig pa mchog dang / nyal ba dang / legs par 'grub tsho par byed pa dang / rdo rje sde dang / dpung bzang dang / ral pa gyen brjes dang / rig pa bzang po dang / legs 'grub dang / sde bzang dang /stobs po che dang / rnam par 'joms pa dang / ki lī ki la dang / mchog dang / legs 'dul dang / 'gro lding ba dang / sngon rabs dang / rin chen ke 95)snyi dang / byis pa'i ke 6snyi dang / legs par ke )phri dang / legs par gang ba dang / gang ba chen po dang / lha mthar byed dang / rdo rje chen po dang / 'bar ba zhes pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams sngags kyi rgyal po chen po ste/kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ rma bya la nye bar 'dug pa/ ut+pa la ltar sngo bsangs(8/ bzhin cung zad khro gnyer du byas pa/ phyag g.yon pas 9bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 7'tshal bar byed bzhin pa'o/ /'di dag gi 'og tu rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo bri bar bya ste/ 'di lta ste bcom ldan 'das mā ma 11khri dang / rdo rje lcags kyu ma dang / rdo rje lcags sgrog ma dang / rdo rje rgyal ma dang / rdo rje rnam par rgyal ma dang / dmar po ldan ma dang / grags ldan ma dang / bi shi ni rdo rje spyan ma dang / rdo rje khro gnyer 1 ma dang / rdo rje 94—347

khu tshur ma dang / rdo rje mi 'jigs ma dang / rdo rje phreng ba ma dang / rdo rje sgra ldan ma dang / rdo rje dge legs ma dang / rdo rje 'dzin ma dang / rdo rje ma mo dang / rdo rje gzhan gyis mi thub ma dang / rdo rje gnam lcags ma dang / dus kyi rdo rje ma dang / rdo rje gtsug phud ma dang / rdo rje bka' bsgo chen mo dang /rdo rje 'od dang / rgyal ba ldan ma dang / rdo rje gzugs ldan ma dang / rdo rje spyan ma zhes pa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po 'di rnams rdo rje'i 91)rigs kyi rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo ste/ rma bya la nye bar 'dug pa/ ut+pa la ltar sngo bsangs kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa cung zad bzhin khro gnyer dang ldan par byas pa dang / dar dang ras kyi sham thabs dang / dar la'i stod g.yogs mnabs rin pa / g.yon pa rdo rje dang / g.yas pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal bzhin pa/ lhas bstod pa'i gzugs 'chang ba'o/ /de 8)rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan la lta bar gyur pa/ rang gi gzugs dang cha byad dang dbyibs bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi cagayas kyi gzhogs su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ston ku'i rinasprin ltar dkar ba/ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ 'od dpag med dbus su bzhugs pa/ dar la'i stod g.yogs can dar la dang ras kyi sham thabs can/ rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ phyag g.yon pas pad+ma'i phyag rgya ri/ g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das la rnga yab g.yob par byed pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la sems dpa' chen po'i mtshan gyis brgyan 7par byas pa'i lus can/ cung zad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan la lta ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yon du 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje ut+pa la sngon po'i 'dab ma'i kha dog can/ pad+ma'i 94—348

gdan la rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa/ rab tu dang ba'i sku/ dar dang ras kyi sham thabs tsarican/ stod g.yogs dmar po mnabs napa/ phyag g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal bzhin pa/ phyag g.yon pas rnga yab kyis brel ba/ 'bar bas 'khrugs pa'i spyan cicung zad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan la lta bar gyur pa'o/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi g.yas su bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma chen po pri 5yang ku ltar sngo bsangs ma / kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ rab tu dang ba'i sku/pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ cung zad 'dzum bzhin pa/ dar dang ras kyi sham thabs can/ stod g.yogs dmar po mnabs 6pa/ phyag g.yon pas ut+pa la yongs su bzung nas g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal bzhin pa/ lus cung zad 'dud pa/ lang tsho dang po can/ ha cang mi sbom/ha cang mi phra ba'i bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma bri bar bya'o/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi g.yas su phreng gcig 7la brten pa'i rig pa'i rgyal po chen po bco brgyad la 'di lta ste/ bcom ldan 'das phyag mtha' yas pa dang / phyag stong pa dang / phyag brgya pa dang / phyag bcu gnyis pa dang / phyag drug pa dang / phyag bzhi pa dang / zhabs stong pa dang / zhabs brgya pa dang /zhabs bcu gnyis pa dang / zhabs drug pa dang / zhabs bzhi pa dang / rta mgrin dang / don yod zhags pa dang / 'od zer stong gis rnam par snang ba dang / mgrin pa dkar pos 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dang /mtha' yas rnam rgyal dang / rnam rgyal chen po dang / lha'i mtha' dang /mtha' dpag tu med pa dang / yid kyi nashing rta dang / mi 'jigs pa sbyin 94—349

pa zhes pa rig pa'i rgyal po chen po 'di rnams pad+ma'i rigs kyi gtso bo srid par 'jug pa nye bar spyod par byed pa/ kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/pad+ma'i lus kyis nye bar bskor ba'i lus phyag na pad+ma dang / g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa/ cung zad sgrol ma la lta bar gyur pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma'i nye logs su gos dkar mo pad+ma'i gdan la nye bar 'dug pa/ rab tu dang ba'i sku/ ral pa'i cod pan 'chang ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan la lta bar gyur pa/ phyag na pad+ma rab tu rgyas pa dang / g.yas pas bgrang phreng bsnams pa'o/ / de'i yang (1stagayas su phreng gcig gel brten ris)pa'i pad+ma'i rigs kyi las kyi paragatso mo bcu bzhi bri bar bya ba la 'di lta ste/bcom ldan 'das ma khro gnyer can dang / dkar mo dang / dkar mo chen mo dang / dpal mdun rim dang / pad+ma go po tsiririg dang / grags ldan ma dang /sangs rgyas dpa' ba'i zla ba ma dang / longs spyod ldan ma dang / bde ldan ma dang / grags pa ldan ma dang / shes rab gos can ma dang / stobs gcig ma dang / stobs mang po dang / stobs bcu ma dang / sangs rgyas kyi yum dang / byang chub kyi yan lag gi yum zhes pa 'di rnams rig pa'i rgyal mo chen mo ste / kun nas 'bar ba'i phreng bas 'khrugs pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/rgyan thams cad kyis 7rnam par brgyan pa/ lha'i bud med kyi cha byad 'chang ba/rab tu dang ba'i sku/ cung zad sgrol ma'i gzugs brnyan la lta bar gyur pa'o/ /pad+ma bsnams zhing nagayas pas mchog sbyin pa/ rang gi gzugs su bri bar bya'o//sgrol ma'i 'og tu ci bgyi zhes bya ba bcom ldan 'das las 'phags ma sgrol ma'i khro bo chen po zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ pad+ma'i gdan la gnas pa/ lus 94—350

brtan pa/ nag po mthar byed pa'i gzugs can/ khro gnyer du byas pa/mche ba gtsigs pa/ zhal gcig gis drag tu bzhad pas gdangs bzhin pa/gnyis pa de bzhin gshegs pa la lta bzhin pa/ dang pos sgrol ma lta ba'o/ /phyag dang pos rin po che mthong ba 'byin par byed bzhin pa/ g.yon dang pos zhags pa bsnams pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i bka' nod par byed bzhin pa'o/ /de'i yang g.yas su khro bo chen po sgrol mas non pa zhes bya ba lha chen po la nye bar 'dug pa/ pad+ma'i chu bas dkris pa'i lus can/ ut+pa la ltar sngo bsangs/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bka' nod par byed bzhin pa bri bar bya'o/ /'jug pa dang dbang bskur ba'i cho ga thams cad sngar brjod pa kho na'o/ /ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud phyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i cho ga'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ral pa gyen brjes kyi rtog pa'i rgyal po chen por rang gi snying po sbyin par bgyi'o/ /gang gis brjod pa tsam gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin mngon du 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa dang / nye bar 'tshe ba dang / nad 'go ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la legs so zhes bya ba byin te/ spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug legs so/ /khyod kyis smros shig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 94—351

gis rang gi 0)snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di gsungs so/ /de nas 'di las dkyil 'khor che/ /dam pa yang dag rab 'chang (7byed/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnam pa ru/ /phyi yi dkyil 'khor kun tu bri/ /de yi dbus su srad bu mnyam/ /gru bzhi yongs su bskor bar ri bya/ /gnyis par 'joms pa po song ste/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bri bar bya/ /dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi tshul gyis ni/ /ri mo bzhi po rnams kyang ngo / /pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri bar bya/ /pad+ma yi ge ze 'bru (5)la/ /'jig rten mgon po dgod 6par bya/ /pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i phreng ba rnams/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan kun tu bri/ /de ru slob dpon rab bzhugs nas/ /pad+ma chen po'i phyag rgya mchog /dkyil 'khor gnas la nyer 'dug pas/ /mnyam par bzhag 7pas mnyam par dgod/ /ji ltar chu la pad+ma gang / /gnas kyi nyes pa mang pos kyang / /gos par mi 'gyur de bzhin 'dir/ /'gro la chags pas yang dag byed/ /lan cig (na 'di gsungs dper brjod nas/ /de nas lcags kyu mchog dag gis/ /yang dag bkug nas pad+ma che/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang grol bar 'gyur/ /de la 'di ni pad+ma'i lcags kyu chen (9)po'o/ /oṃ ma hā pad+mo hūm̐ dza hrī/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'ongs nas slob dpon la mthong ba sbyin par byed do/ /yang na 'od zer gtong 9bar byed do/ /de nas 'di nyid kyi (1phyag rgyas slob ma rab tu gzhug par bya ste/ dar dkar pos 'gos dkar po dang / gtsug tor dkar pos mgo bo dkri bar bya'o/ /'di nyid 'jig rten du rab tu brjod nas de nas smros shig ces sna so/ /de nas pad+ma lag pa g.yon du byin nas g.yas pas chu snod byin te 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad pad+ma che/ /94—352

pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor dam pa ni(1)/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /de nyid lhan cig brtag par bya/ /zhes so/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po bcing ba dang ting nge 'dzin yang bslab par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i pad+ma zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po'o/ /de nas pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor bris nas dbus kyi ze 'bru la nye bar 'dug ste stong phrag brgya bzlas par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ting nge 'dzin ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma rgyas pa de la kun tu gzigs par byed pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug nyid thob par byed do/ /zhes pad+ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas dam tshig gi (snyedakyil 'khor 'byung ste/ de bzhin kho nas dadakyil 'khor brtag par byas nas dbus su pad+ma stong dgod du gzhug go/ /de nas pad+ma stong po de bcom ldan 'das la dbul bar bya ste/ lan re lan re yongs su bzlas nas so/ /de nas slob ma rab tu bcug nas dam tshig brjod par bya'o/ /bu dang slob ma'i ched du yang / /dam tshig nyams par mi bya ste/ /dam tshig bdag la brjod par bya/ /gang phyir pad+ma'i rnam pa las/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags cathams cad dag /dam tshig gi ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /las kyi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /mchod pa rnam pa bzhi yis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad yid kyis mchod / /lus kyis spyan ras gzigs mgon la/ /ngag gis phyag na rdo rje la/ /las las nam mkha'i snying por skyes/ /ji ltar sgrub thabs cho gar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug ri rab lhun po'i ri'i rtse mor 'khod pa rang gi ting nge 'dzin gyis kun tu gnas pa'i sku thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku brgyad do zhes so/ /de nas dkar po'i phyogs kyi 594—353

tshes gcig nas brtsams te/ rtag tu thams cad dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rgyun du bzlas pas ji srid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug mngon du gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku rnams 'phros nas sgrub pa po'i pad+ma'i dbus su 'khod de slar yang de nas sangs rgyas kyi sku gzhan 'byung ste sgrub pa po la mngon par dbang bskur ba gnas shing brtan par 'gyur ro/ /de nas bdag gi 1dngos po thams cad spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang mtshungs pa skad cig de la bde ba dang ldan pa dang / ji srid du 'phur bar byed do/ /sems can thams cad dbang du 'gyur zhing tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /de nas sgrub pa gzhan dang las chen po thams cad 'byung ste/ 'bum bzlas pas las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gnyis bzlas pas mtshams med pa la sogs pa'i sdig pa thams cad lhag ma med par zad par 'gyur ro/ /'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas bsod nams thams cad mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas gnod sbyin gyi dngos grub thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs tsho pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad ni 'bum/ zab sum cu rtsa lnga ri ribazlas pas 44thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de nas phyag rgya chen po ni mchod rten stong phrag brgya byas nas mthar cho gas rimatshan thog thag tu bzlas pa ri bya'o/ /de nas tho rangs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byon nas snying khar 7rab tu 'jug par byed do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' so sor rnyed do/ /de nas zhal du rab tu 'jug par byed do/ /de nas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug so sor rnyed do/ /ma bsgrubs par yang las thams cad du 'gyur ro/ /thog mar brjod pas gzhan 94—354

gyi grong dang grong khyer srung ba dang / mdzes par spyan drangs 1pas thams cad bya'o / /'bebs pa la tsan+dan gyi bdug dpas gdon 'bebs so/ / shi rī ṣa'i me tog gis sems can dbang du byed do/ /dri bzang po'i me tog gis 4sems can thams cad rengs par byed do/ /sa dkar pos bud med do/ /dri zhim po'i me tog gis chom rkun rengs pa'o/ /yungs kur dkar po'i sbyin sreg gis ri dgas (5)dang bya rengs so/ /yungs kur dkar po gtor bas mig 'phrul ston par byed do/ /rma bya'i nu mas rmi lam ston par byed do/ /dus gsum du bzlas pas rmi lam ngan pa 'joms par byed do/ /til gyi sbyin sreg gis sems can thams cad rengs par byed do/ /bya gag gi gshog 6pa'i sbyin sreg gis rgyal po dbang du byed do/ /rgyal po 'khyil 7pa'i me tog gi 8sbyin sreg gis 'dod pa thams cad dbang du byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la mchod pa byas nas mtshan mo brgyad smyung bar gnas pas bzlas pa bya'o / /de nas 'dod pa thams cad thob par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po'i btsun mo'i mchog dbang du byed pa la bud med kyi dbang po'i spu'i 1 sbyin sreg gis so/ /bu mo dbang du byed pa la yang ngo / /don gzhan la yang sbyin sreg dang bcas pas spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 11gi mdun du nyi ma re rer dus gsum du bzlas pa bya'o/ /ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud phyi mar 1 las chen po thams cad kyi sgyu 1lha'aphrul lo// //de nas sems dpa' chen po de 7ting nge 'dzin de nyid sgom bzhin du khro bo'i rgyal po sgrol mas non pa'i mnyam par 'dzin pa'i gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 94—355

gsungs so/ /khru lnga pa dang sgo bzhi dang / /sgo khyud rta babs nges gnas pa/ /phyi rol pad+ma'i rnam par bya/ /de nas kun nas grwa 6)rnams su'ang / /de ni legs par bsams byas nas/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /sngar brjod snying po 'di yis ni/ /zlos bzhin 'di ni bsrung ②ba dang / /dkar po dmar po ser po dang / /nag po ljang gu'i nunyetshon sna lnga'i/ /phye ma 'jam po rnams kyis ni / /sgrol ma'i rig pas mngon bsngags pas/ /bsgrub bya bcom ldan 'das ni bya/ /khro bo'i rgyal po mdun du ste/ /g.yon du ral pa gcig ma bya/ /g.yas su 'dam 54)skyes phyi rol gyi/ /sgo khyud snying por ji rigs grub/ /yongs su 'dod pas rdo rigs bya/ /dri yi phye mas yongs su byang (5)/ /rdo rje khu tshur stobs po che/ /gang du 'jig rten gsum cho ga /rdo rje 'chang chen 'dod pa yis/ /'das pas rnam par thim par 'gyur/ /khu tshur rdo rje khu tshur bcas/ /de ni g.yas kyi sgo khang du/ /stobs po che ni rab bzhag nas/ /nya yis mgrin par stobs po che/ /nub phyogs su ni bya ba'o/ /g.yas kyi phyi yi sgo khang du/ /de bzhin dbang phyug chen po bya/ /de la mdung gi phyag rgya dgod/ /ji 'dra'i u ma bri bar bya/ /lho yi grwa gnyis su bya ba/ /(5)phyag rgya rnam pa sna tshogs pa'o/ /nub dang byang gi grwa rnams su/ /log 'dren phyag rgya rdo rje'o/ /byang gi grwa gnyis rnams su ni/ /mkhas pas rigs kyi phyag rgya 57bya/ /shar gyi grwa gcig (kyernams su ni/ /ma mo tshogs kyi phyag rgya dgod/ /blang 9༄gi ri ṭa 7log 'dren bcas/ /de nas ji ltar 'byor pa yi/1/ /cho gas ji bzhin lha rnams mchod/ /khro bo stobs chen sgrol mas non/ /bzlas pas bdag nyid bsrung bar bya/ /ka ra bī ra ta la ni ge/ /blangs nas rang gnas smyung gnas pas/ /mkhas pas byang gi 94—356

sgo khang du/ /gtsang ma 5)gang du rab 'jug bya/ /blo dang ldan pas spyan drang bya//khro bo'i rgyal pos thams cad nas/ /ji ltar rig pa'i cho ga yis/ /tshar bcad rjes su 'dzin pa'i mchog /gdon dang lus kyi las rnams ni/ /de nyid du ni nges par bya/ /tshar bcad dam tshig bde ba 'dri/ /gdon 'pho byed dang za byed dang / /gang zhig la la gsod pa dang / /de bzhin sgrib pa sbyang ba dang / /sems can dzubarnams ni thams cad nyid/ /sgrub ‘ )thabs bya dang 'khrul 'khor ni/ /ji 'dra ba yi ④bya ba dang / /mkhas pas las ni stong dag dang / /gdon rnams bod par byed pa dang / /rang gi rigs dang gzhan rigs kyi/ /phyag rgya nye bar mtshon par bya/ /'di yi dkyil 'khor thams cad nas/ /'byung po'i tshogs la sogs pa kun/ /de nas gtor ma bdug pa sogs/ /rgyas pas mngon par mchod byar gyis/ /de yis gdon mthong de mchod bya/ /phyis kyi dbang las dul ba thob/ /skye bos btung ba sbyin sreg la/ /sogs pa rnam par gzhom par bya/ /shi ṣa lān tsa na blangs nas/ /gdon thob pa ni 'pho bar bya/ /srin po rnams kyis byin pa'i mchu75ci/ /mthong ba de 'dra'i tshon nernams dang / /sha za rnams la ri bong can/ /mig mi 'dzums 7par 'dzag pa yi/ /'jigs pa mthong na sna tshogs pa/ /kun tu rnam par lta bar byed/ /skem 2byed gdon gyi rnam 'gyur gang / /nus dang dpung pa brten pa yi9/ /dgra bo rnams ni thams cad du/ /lha dang mtshon cha'i bya ba ni/ /pad+ma byed dang ral pa dang / /dbyug gu bgrang phreng 'jigs pa'i gnas/ /ril ba spyi blugs mi thub nyid/ /phyag rgya bram ze can zhes bshad/ /rtse gsum kun dang zla phyed dang / /ral pa mig la sogs pa dang / /khyu mchog sgra dang drag po dang / /dbang ldan rnams 94—357

te bdun (1)du grags/ /shasti nagadengs ka ba dan dang / /khyim bya de bzhin rma bya'i mjug /phyag rgya gzhon nu ma can bshad/ /'khor lo dung dang be con nyid / /ral gri phub nyid nam mkha' ( )lding / /mgo nyid phyag rgya khyab 'jug bshad / /che 4ba sprin ni lha chen po'i/ /bum pa gtun shing de bzhin du/ /ngang pa'ang g.yon gzhogs phyag rgya ste/ /phyag rgya la hi ri kur 557bshad/ /nam gru rnams dang gtor zan dang / /rgan po gtum po mthong ba ni/ /nam gru dkar po rnams kyi rgya/ /rang gi gzugs nyid mthong ba ni/ /mdangs 'phrog (phyirarnams kyi 7lhung bzed dang 8/ /'dregs (9 par byed pa grol ba'o/ /de nas mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'byung ste/ byed pa thams cad dge ba la/ /shing gcig 1 gam ni dur khrod dam skye/ /khang stong gtsang ma tsha 8sgo med pa'i sa gzhi mthong nas sgrub pa po khros pas sa la ma lhung ba'i ba lang gi lci bas tsho dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs te re khā mugasum der bya'o/ /kun nas khru bzhi pa la dang por thal ba'i re khā'o15/ /gnyis pa ri'i btsag gis so9/ /gsum pa sol ba'i phye mas rab tu 'bad pas bri bar bya'o/ /byang ngam nub tu yang sgo gcig sna byed du gzhug go/ /sgo'i dbus su yang lha chen po lag na mdung thogs pa bya'o/ /snam bu'i nang du sangs rgyas bden par rmad du byung ba'i bdag nyid can bya'o/ /sangs rgyas 19g.yas kyi gzhogs su sgrol mas non pa rnam par dgod par bya'o/ /g.yon du dpa' mo chen mo stobs mo che ma 2 ral pa gcig ru ma bzhag nas/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku rgyab tu dgod par bya ba ni klu'i nu rgyal po mtha' yas dang /de bzhin du 'jog po dang / dpa' bo chen po stobs kyi rgyu yang dgod par bya'o//de bzhin du pad+ma dang / pad+ma chen po dang / dung skyong dang / rigs ldan 94wa 358

stobs po che'i nang du mngon par brjod pa'o/ /lha de rnams ni 'khor dang bcas pa snam bu gang bar dgod par bya'o/ /'di thams cad nas ma mo'i tshogs rnam par med par bya ste/ dpal ldan ma ni snam 1bu'o/ /sgo ru spre'u dang / ra (shedang / bum rnam ( niyang sgo'i spyan pa ra ba yi yang ngo / /nag po'i brgyad pa la lha rnams lto 'phye chen po las ma 'das pa yang dag par mchod de/stong phrag bzlas par bya'o/ /shes rab can sngags kyi rgyal po grub par 'gyur ro/ /rims dang gdon thams cad las 'byin pa dang / rtsod pa yang rnam par 'joms par byed do/ /rang gnas su 'jug go/ /de nas gsang sngags 'di yang rtag tu bzlas pa'i gu gul gyi chu'am ku shas gzhan gyis mi thub pa dang / zhi ba can dang / rgyas pa can dang / mngon par mdzes pa can nyid spyad pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin rab tu byas par grub ste/ thams cad 'joms pa sgrol mas non pa gang yin pa de ni cagasang ba'i sgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor ro5/ /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal phyinas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gis mngon par shes pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog la mngon sum du thos pa de nas byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis ha la ha la zhes bya 7ba'i snying po ral pa gyen brdzes kyi rgyud phyi mar sems can gyi don gyi phyir dang /sgrol ma'i mthu bstan pa'i phyir dang / thabs la mkhas pa'i snying rje bdag gis 8bshad par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byams pa smros shig /na maḥsarba 9ta thā ga te bh+yo/ ma hā pu ru ṣa ri ṣa bhe bh+yaḥn ma ār+ya a ba lo 94—359

ki te shwa ra ma hā s+thā ma māsta mi tri 1)ya mañdzu shrī badz+ra pā ṇi pra bh+ri (bti bh+yo ma hā sa twe bh+yaḥ/de rnams la phyag byas nas bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug khyod kyi snying po 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sgrub par byed pa sems can thams cad kyis mi tshugs pa srid pa'i lam rnam par 'joms par byed pa brjod par bgyi'o/ /sār+ya na the rda/ he bo dhi satā(4)/ ma hā satā/ he ha le/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya(5/ pa ra ma be+e tri tsit+ta hi (7ta tsit+ta kā ru ṇi kā māṃ/ ga ma bi ya ti/ ma hā bi ya ti/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dhu ru tsa len+t+ra(me/ ba la na ma ste stu/sarba nasatā/ bha 9ya pra ta/ ha ri ha ri ⑩ha ri bā ha rnam ba/ bha bā na kha/tu ru tu ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ su ru su ru/ su pra shā si/ pā ma la mūrti/ ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ kroṣ+ṭha dzi na/ dza ṭā mu ku ṭā ba la mu tā la mā /mel ba la ma la ma la/ ka la ka la/ na la/na/ ha la ha la/ hu lu hu lu/ he bo dhi satā/pri ya bo dhi satā/ ma hā bo dhi satā/ na ma te ru/ ku ru ku ru/ skṛ da yaṃ/ ma nu sma ra/ i rda tsa me/ kār+ya ku ru swā hā/ 'di ni bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis 1 byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ha la ha la zhes bya ba'i snying po ste/ nyi ma so sor tho rangs langs nas sko bcom ldan 'das kyi dkyil 'khor byas te dri dang me tog la sogs pa mngon par bkram nas/ de nas lan bcu gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de nas nad thams cad nye bar zhi bar byed do/ /zla ba drug kho nar byas pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du yid kyi shing rta yongs su rdzogs par byed do/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis smras pa/ gal te mtshams med pa byas pas kyang ma grub pa na de'i tshe nga mtshams med pa byas pa 94wa 360

dang / bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bslus par gyur cig ces so0) / /de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nanas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su skyes pa/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i rtog dpa chen po'i rgyud phyi mar 'jigs (4)pa thams cad kyi rig pa sring mo bzhi gong nas gong du rab tu 'jug bzhin pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis 5rnam par gzigs par gyur pa/ rtog pa 6)bzhir skyes pa/ thung ngu'i gzugs can/nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ sa 'og dang / mi snang ba dang / ro langs dang /'thab rtsod dang / rkang pas rab tu bgrod pa dang / rgyas pa can dang /mngon spyod can dang / dbang du byed pa dang / skal ba 7bzang po nyid rab tu sbyin pa po tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa rnams kyis gsungs pa las bzlog pa/ rang bzhin gyi mtshan nyid can gyis lhag pa'i cha khyim du skyes pa kun tu ston par byed pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i mkhyen pa'i mthu'i don gyis ched stong phrag pas kyang stong phrag brgya po des kyang lan cig 8)gzhom pa tsam dang / dpe tsam du byang chub sems dpa'i yul 'jig rten du ma'i 'byung gnas rang bzhin du gnas pa la ltos nas ral pa gyen brjes kyi rgyud phyi mar bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su sgrub pa 'di rnams gsungs pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das yid dbang du gyur pa dngos grub rab tu stsol (9)bar mdzad par gyur to/ /tar+ya thā/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/na mo a.ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satā ya/ o dza ye swā hā/ rgyal ma zhes bya ba'o/ /tabya thā/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā 94—361

ya / o bi dza ya swā hā/ rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'o/ /tabya thā/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā 917ya/ o a dzi te swā hā/ mi thub ma zhes bya ba'o/ /na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ o a pa rā naridzi te swā hā/ri gzhan gyis mi thub ma zhes bya ba'o zhes pa de lta bu sring mo bzhi'o / /lnga pa ming po ni/ na mo a mi tā bhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ ar+ha te/ na ma ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa rā ya/ o ki ni ki ni sarba ta thā ga tā usta ba shārnye/ ba ra de / ut+ta ma ta thā ga tā ut+ta ba hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ming po tum ri bu ru zhes pa'o/ /sngags kyi rgyal po yongs su bsgrags/ /mdor na nga rgyal can rlom pa/ /phyi ma'i rgyud kyi las rnams ni/ /ji lta ji ltar rab sbyar ba/ /de lta de ltar sgrub par byed / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje rang gi rdzu 'phrul yang dag par bstan par 'dod pas/ stan las langs nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ rang gi rdo rje yang dag par skul ri bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin de las bzhengs te byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la 'di skad ces smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag kyang rtog pa'i rgyal po rgyud phyi ma 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i mthu kun tu bstan pa'i don du 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi mchod rten rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa sbyin par bgyi'o/ /de la rjes su yi rang ba'i ra sems dpa' 6chen po phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe mchog gi grub pa dang / mchog gi las byed pa tshul khrims 'chal pa rnams kyang khyad par du 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'phags ma sgrol ma'i rjes su spyod pa pos gang rtul ba las byung ba 'di rnams rigs dang /94—362

pha rol gnon par byed pa'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so/ /phyag na rdo rje gsungs shig /de nas phyag na rdo rjes slar yang ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so1/ /phyag na rdo rje snyoms par zhugs pa de ma thag tu stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di kun tu snang bar byas so/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes phyag gi sor mo rab tu brkyang ste / rdo rje rab tu 'joms pa zhes bya ba dang / rdo rje khu tshur dang / rdo rje dmar po dang / rdo rje mthar phyin dang / rdo rje nag po ste g.yon pa'i phyag 2las byung ba 'di rnams bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i spun rnams so/ /de nas de rnams bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal bar byed par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag na rdo rje dang / spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la yang ngo //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzhon nu'i spun lnga po rnams la legs so zhes bka' stsal pa ste ri/ sems can rnams kyi 5bsod nams 'byung bar 'gyur ba dang / dngos grub sbyin par byed pa sgrol ma'i rtog par don chen po sbyin pa phyag na rdo rje'i rigs las byung ba pad+ma'i phyag la mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'o/ /de nas phyag na rdo rjes dkyil 'khor gsungs par gyur to/ /gcig gnyis gsum bzhi lnga dang ni/ /ji srid khru ni brgyad kyi bar/ /nor 'dod pa yis khru gcig sne ste/ /bu 'dod pa yis khru gnyis so/ /dgra nyams byed pas khru gsum mo/ /bzlas pa nyid kyis khru bzhi'o/ /lnga pa dngos grub thams cad la/ /brgyad pa mkha' la 'gro ba yis/ /sa 'og don dang 'bab chu dang / /rgya mtsho dang ni dngos grub gnas / /khyim du'ang rung ste gtsang ma yi/ /gzhan du g.yogs par byas pa 94—363

dang / /las la shis pa gang rung gis/ /thig gis 6)dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya / /gru bzhi pa la grwa bzhi pa/ /sgo bzhi rta babs rgyan gyis brgyan/ /dkyil 'khor cha gsum byas pa yis/ /steng gi cha ru bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma'i gdan gnas pa/ /chos ston par ni mdzad bzhin pa/ /g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /tshangs pa'i dbyug pa spyi blugs phyag /g.yon du 'phags pa phyag rdo rje/ /rdo rje'i phyag gam de gzhogs su/ /khyab 'jug dung dang 'khor lo ste/ /be con phyag na 'khor lo'o/ /dbus kyi cha ru gru la zhon/ /gru yi srog shing sgreng ba'o/ /dang por rdo rje rab 'joms dang / /sgyu 'phrul dang ni tum bu ru/ /gnyis par rdo rje khu tshur dang / /rgyal mar bcas pa'o gsum pa ru/ /lus dmar dang ni rnam rgyal bcas/ /bzhi par rdo rje bsags mtha' dang / /mi nathub mar bcas lnga pa ru/ /lto nag gzhan mi thub dang bcas/ /ljang gu dkar po dmar po dang / /ser po nag po go rims bzhin/ /lha rnams dgod par byas nas ni/ /dkar po'i gos dang dkar po'i rgyan/ /be con rdo rje gtun shing dang / /gzhu dang ral gri mtshon cha'i phyag /dbus su zla nyi ri ripad+ma la/ /lha rnams mngon sum dgod par bya/ /gru yi 'og tu me dang ni/ /chu yi gter ni gnas par bya/ /dung dang nya budang chu srin gyis/ /rnam par brgyan tsi pa'i shar dang lho/ /nub dang byang du dbang po dang / /gshin rje chu lha lus ngan rnams/ /bzhon pa bcas shing phyag rgyar bcas/ /legs par dkris pa'i bum pa ni/ /dri yi chu yis yongs su bkang / /yal 'dab kyis ni nye bar mdzes / /grwa 7༄rnams su ni dgod par bya/ /'dir ni bum pa lnga pa ni/ /rin chen gyis brgyan ri 'jam pa yi/ /gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa dang / /sa ha ka 94—364

ra'i yal 'dab 1)kyis/ /kha ni dgab par byas pa dang / /gdugs sgreng me tog phreng ba dpyangs(5ni/ /shar gyi sgo ru dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'a khor phyi ru rgya mtsho bzhi/ /dung dang pad+ma la sogs kyis/ /ri yi rtse mo yis kyang bya/ /rgyal mtshan rnams 'khrugs bla re bres/ /in+d+ra nī la gser dang ni/ /dngul dang zangs dang lcags rnams kyi/ /phye mas dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /lha yi me tog bdug pas bdug /rnam pa sna tshogs gtor mas mchod/ /dus kyis non pa'i me tog 'bras/ /dbyig gser sna tshogs rin chen dang / /bza' ba phyi rol gcal du dgram/ /ri bo'i steng du rab 'jug bya/ /snying po phyi mas spyan drang sogs/ /las rnams kun dang gshegs su gsol/ /de nas gang gis dkon mchog gsum/ /dad pas byang chub sems bskyed de/ /bud med skyes pa gzhon nu yi/ /bsnyen gnas byas pa gos kyis ni/ /gdong ni nye bar bcings pa yis/ /dam tshig gis kyang mnyan par gyis/ /dbyig dang gser gyi me tog gis / /lag pa yis kyang dor bar bya/ /de ni gang du lhung gyur pa/ /de yi rigs 'gyur de nas ni/ /gdong phye lha rnams bstan par bya/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rnams kyang 'gyur/ /yang na nyin dang mtshan mo ru/ /dkyil 'khor de bri mnyes par 'gyur/ /de nas gzugs brnyan 'byung ste/ a shwat+tha dang / n+ya gro dha dang / u dum bā 4)ra zhi ba can dang / tsū ta dang / tsam pa ka dang /nā (3)ga ge sar gyis rgyas pa can dang / bil ba dang / a riṣ+ṭa dang / ko ṭha yis mngon spyod can no/ /dbang du byed pa dang skal ba ngan pa rnams la bad kun mthar byed dang / shasma li dang / dīr+gha bit+ta'o/ /smyo bar byed pa la tsan+dan dang / mya ngan med pa'i shing dang / sbrang rtsi dang / myos byed rnams 94—365

so / /skal ba bzang po nyid la asbi dat+ta las byung ba rnams so/ /las thams cad pa la gser las byung ba'o/ /rgyal srid 'dod pas ni dngul las byung ba'o/ /zangs ni skal ba bzang po'i ched du'o/ /lcags las byung ba ni mngon spyod can no / /nyams par byed pa la tsam pa ka dang / nā 51)ga ge sar dang / ba gu la dang / a ti muk+ta ku'o/ /nor 'dod pa yis ni ri sna ma dang / yu thi ka dang /mal+li ka dang / myos byed dang / gser shing dang / mā li ka rnams so/ /skal ba bzang po 'dod pas ni pad+ma dang / /ku mu da'o/ /zhi ba can la ut+pa la dang / so'u garnyi ma'o/ /rgyas pa can dang / gzhan la yang dri bzang po can gyi me tog go/ /rgyas pa can gang la dris dman pa'i me tog go/ /mngon spyod can dang nyams par byed pa la sogs pa la ni tsan+dan la sogs pa'i dri 'phrog 4nipa'o / /zhi ba can dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang du byed pa dang / skal ba 55cibazang po nyid la de lta bu'i bdug pa lag pa sbyar nas snying po'i sngags 'di rnams kyi las bya'o/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa 56)ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ na mabyu turnye mabha gi nī māṃ/ na mo de ba tum+bu ru snar+sha kā nasaha ya/ dzam+bha ni / dzasti ka ro ti a mi traṃ/ s+t+waṃ bha ni/ s+t+waṃ bhi ri9ka ro t+ya/ mi traṃ/ mo ha ni /mo tī ka ro t+ya mi traṃ/ an+dha ni/ irnyi ka ro t+ya mi traṃ/ dza ye ā gats+tsha bi dza ya 11ā gats+tsha dzam+bha ni ā sna gats+tsha stam+bha ni ā gats+tsha/ ba li ba li/ put+pa/ dhū 1 pa/ u pa hā raṃ / pra ti groṇ+ḍa thā/ sa mā ya ngayu pā lā yā thā/ su ṭu ṭu su sla badz+ra bhañdza nī skal swā hā/ rig pa 'di ni stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir 'gyur te/ 'di lta ste/nam mkha' la 'gro ba dang / phug tu rab tu 'jug pa dang / gter 'pho bar byed pa dang / rig pa 'dzin pa nyid dang / mig sman ldong ros sgrub pa dang /94—366

dbang du byed pa dang / nyams par byed pa dang / gzhan rab tu 'joms pa dang / rang gi yul so sor skyong ba dang / dug dang / pho nya dang / nad 'go ba dang / mche ba rab bsnams la yang dag par gnas pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor bcing ba dang / khros pas rgyal po'i khab rab tu sgrub pa ste/ de lta bu la sogs pa'i las gzhan rnams kyang rang gi 'dod pas bsgrub par bya'o/ /sring mo bzhi'i snying po rdzogs sto1// //de nas slar yang dkyil 'khor gsungs pa khru bzhi pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/kun nas rta babs kyis brgyan smyonapa/ gshin rje dang / chu lha dang / lus ngan rnams bzhin pa dang bcas mtshon cha dang bcas pa'i sgo skyong dang gsum byed du gzhug go/ /byang gi rab tu thob par bya ste cha gsum byas nas steng gi cha ru bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'o/ /'phags pa phyag na rdo rje yang phyag g.yon pas rdo rje dang g.yas pas mchog sbyin pa/ kun nas 'bar ba bri bar bya'o/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i g.yon du rdo rje lcags kyu lcags kyu lag na thogs pa/ gzhan du rdo rje lcags sgrog lcags sgrog lag na thogs pa/ thams cad kyang ri'i rtse mo la yang dag par gnas par bya'o/ /dbang ldan gyi phyogs la brten pa'i lha chen po chung ma dang bcas pa/ khyu mchog dang bcas pa yang dag par bri'o/ /gzhan rnam pa gsum rim gyis mtshon cha dang / gnas dang bcas pa ji lta ba bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /blang kyigi ri ti dang / nag po chen po rnams so/ /nub tu mi sbyin dang (4)/ tum ( bu ru dang / 'od srung dang / sna tshogs bshes gnyen lag pa rnams ril ba spyi blugs dang / chu snod phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /khron pa dang 94—367

srog shing sgreng ba dang / ta ta spu 1)bri'o/ /stod g.yogs ljang gu can lag na be con thogs pa cod pan gyis brgyan 2pa phyag na tog skyong zhi)bsnams pa/ rna ba la rgya skyegs kyis brgyan 4)pa'o/ /rgyal ba dkar po phyag na rdo rje thogs pa/stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs can no/ /rnam par rgyal ba lus dmar po phyag na gtun shing thogs pa/ gos dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ gser gyi kha dog can gyi gzhu phyag na bsnams pa'o/ /gzhan gyis mi thub pa nag mo gos khra bo'i stod g.yogs can/ gos nag po'i sham thabs can phyag na ral gri thogs pa gru la zhon pa'o/ /de nas zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / lha rnams dang / nang du pad+ma rab tu gtor ba bri bar bya'o/ /byang gi sgo ru log 'dren chen po g.yas kyi gzhogs su chu bo rab 5med khor yug tu rdo rje dang / dung dang / la da dang /dpal be'u rnams kyang kun tu bri'o/ /de ltar thams cad yang dag par bris te de nas ji ltar 'byor ba'i gtor ma dang / thug zhi pa rnam pa lnga lnga thodang /bza' ba rnam pa lnga dang / k+ta: di rimang po dang / bza' dkris pa'i bag zan dang / dzasbu li ka dang / zho dang / bu ram dang / mar dang / sbrang rtsi ji ltar rigs ri9pa dbul bar bya'o/ /chu'i bum pa bzhi ji ltar 'dod pa'i yal 'dab 7kyis kha bkab pa dang / bum pa dri'i chu thams cad kyis yongs su bkang ba sa bon thams cad dang / sman thams cad dang / yal 'dab 1stodang /gos kyis mgrin pa dkris pa/ dbyig dang / gser dang rin po che rnams dang / yal 'dab k+ṇi kyis brgyan pa'i bum pa rnam pa lnga lnga rnams dang / phyi ru rin po che rnams kyis mngon par bkram pa'o/ /de lta bu la sogs pa'i bkra shis pa rnams byas nas phyi nas bzlas par bya'o/ /de nas sngon du slob ma rab tu 94—368

gzhug par bya ste/ 'di las gzhan pa'i sngags su 'gyur ba ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ (17na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta ye/ na ma: tun+ta gi nī ṭ+wāṃ ma ma dza yā ya/ mā he ti swā hā/ sngags nasa'adi rnam pa ( brgyad kyis sems can thams cad dbang du byed do/ /me tog dang / yungs gar dang / lan tshwa dang / chu dang thal bas dri med nyid sun 'byin pa'i cha byad kyis kyang ngo / /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mañtsaṇ+ḍa sgyu badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā pa ta g.ye/ na mo bi dza yā ya/ ha ha/ dha li/ ku mā ra ni bisnu 6mu khe ra ṭi sha swā hā/ rig pa 'di 'bum bzlas pas sngon du bsnyen pa byas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas brgya byin gyi gnam lcags phog 7)pa'i shing blangs nas mtshan mo gsum du smyung bar gnas par gyur nas(8ri/ gang du mchod rten ring bsrel dang bcas pa der song nas bum pa bzhi po (9)thams cad kyang me tog dang yal 'dab 7kyis kha brgyan pa bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas ku sha bting zhing bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor lcags gsum bcings pa'i phur bu'am rkang pa g.yon pa lag pa g.yon pas mnan te/ji srid du lag pa 11mi snang bar gyur pa de srid du bzlas par bya'o/ /lag pa gtang 1 bar yang mi bya'o/ /de nas phur bu de dgon par gdab par bya ste/phur bu khyim du 'byung ngo / /cho ga 'di nyid kyis btab nas phur bu rkang pa g.yon pas yang dag par mnan nas dbang du gyis shig /grong khyer 'jig pa'i lag pa btsir bas phyag rgya thams cad dang / dug byas pa rnams kyang 'joms par byed do/ /skye bo'i nang du yang ’ gdab par bya ste thams cad du 'gyur ro/ /gzhan la yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du las rnams sabyed do/ /na mo rat+na tra yā ya / na mañtsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ ma hā yak+ṣa se nā lopa ta laye/ na ma: ta mṛ ṇ+ḍaṃ/94wa 369
